metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: As a side note, let me say that externally connected smart contracts that combine the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: ocean of data out there with the security of the blockchain are fascinating to me, both

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: technically and philosophically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Data is knowledge, and knowledge is power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think the more reliable data sources we integrate into our decision making, especially

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: when those decisions are executed by programs, the more efficient and productive our decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: become.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There are interactions between humans that should not be formalized digitally, like love,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: for example, but for all the others, there's no reason for smart contracts not to automate

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: away the menial parts of life, making more room for good conversation over brisket and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: maybe some vodka with old and new friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast, and here is my conversation with Sergey Nazarov.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I gave away everything I own a few times in my life, and he accidentally survived,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and I don't like stuffed animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What I really liked about it, I got him in a thrift store.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What I liked about him is because I'd never seen a stuffed animal that looks pissed off

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: at life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They're usually smiling in the dumbest of ways, and this guy was just pissed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yeah, I got to tell you, that's actually pretty funny.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I like this guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you had to live only in the digital world or the physical world, which would you choose?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think this is actually a question more about what the fidelity of the digital world

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: would be versus the physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think this type of question, this whole simulation thing actually comes from papers

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: about 20, 30 years ago in the philosophical world where people tried to make this thought

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: experiment of would you be comfortable if everything that was happening to you happened

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in a simulation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What they were trying to do is they were intuitively trying to understand is there some kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: intuitive personal connection we have to something being the real world, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then the Matrix movie actually came out of these papers, and then these ideas made

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: their way into the public consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I personally think that if I had the choice to be in the digital world at the same fidelity

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: as the real world with immortality, I would absolutely go with the digital world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Wait, wait, wait, wait, wait.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: How'd you add the immortality part?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's a, don't get immortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you think about how we would go into the digital world, right, our brain patterns would

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: be mapped onto some kind of probably virtual machine, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that would mean immortality, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because the virtual machine has no limit to how long it can exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, don't you think there would be like a versioning system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Like there'd be, this is a soft fork versus hard fork question, whether Sergey version

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: 2.0 would be different from Sergey version 1.0.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There'll be an upgrade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So that's the mortality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Sergey 1.0 would die in the digital world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And you get like a software update and then that's it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well yeah, when people go into the Star Trek transporter, are they killed or are they transported?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I don't really know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I haven't read any papers on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I haven't really thought about it too much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There's no white paper on the transporter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Not at this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So what does fidelity mean exactly to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Is it like strictly, so the fidelity of the physics world, the physical world is maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: now questions of physics, quantum mechanics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What is at the bottom of it all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Or do you mean the fidelity of the actual experience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's just perception.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's just perception.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But that's limited by human cognitive capabilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It is, but I don't really have anything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think all of these papers that brought up these questions of assimilation, they were

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: like in epistemology and metaphysics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And what they were trying to do, I think, was they were trying to put people through

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: a thought experiment where they would come out on the other end and say the reality of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: life is really worth something and ignorance isn't bliss, which is that consistent statement

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in The Matrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Ignorance is bliss.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's what one of the guys says when he's doing something wrong and trying to get back

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: into The Matrix.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And the question is, is ignorance bliss?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And it's like a different version of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think from a perceptual point of view, if my perceptions aren't in any way different,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: so fidelity is very good, it doesn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If I don't know something, it doesn't really exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And if it doesn't exist in my perception or my consciousness, then it doesn't exist, period

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: for me at least.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then whether it exists in some more metaphysical version of things, I personally never really

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: got into the metaphysics stuff because I could never really...

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I couldn't understand what the point of it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's one of these things where I couldn't really get what the practical application

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of it was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And this is from those realm of questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If there was something about the world but you didn't have a capacity to perceive it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: would it matter to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: To me, it wouldn't matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: To me, by the way, the simulation thing is a really interesting engineering question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: which is how difficult is it to engineer a virtual reality, a digital world that is sufficiently

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of high fidelity where you would want to live in it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think that's a really testable and a fascinating engineering question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because my intuition says it's not as difficult as we think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's not nearly as difficult as having to create a quantum mechanical simulation that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: large enough to capture the full human experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It might be just as simple as just a really nice Quake game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: With a nice engine, just creating all the basic visual elements that trick our cognitive

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: tourists, our visual cortex into believing that we're actually in the physical environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think that if that's true, then that's quite...

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: A high fidelity digital world is actually achievable within a century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that changes things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yeah, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Maybe in our lifetime.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I'm really hoping for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I'm hoping somebody can copy my brain waves onto a virtual machine and allow that consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to continue to exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Whether that's death or not, I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But I think it's actually going to require some serious leaps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Even the VR headsets, they don't work if they go below 90 frame rates.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: People start getting freaked out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you have to go from one gaming screen of 60 frames per second to two screens of 90

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: frames per second.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so people's hardware today can't even handle that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's for these two little screens by your eyeballs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What it's going to take to completely trick my consciousness into not knowing the difference

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in terms of all the sensory inputs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I'm keeping my fingers crossed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Whoever does that and is close to doing that, they should contact me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I want to have my brain waves turned into a virtual machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Would you in that context, if Morpheus came to you, would you take the blue pill or the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: red pill?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Meaning, would you be happy just living in that world and not knowing that you're living

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: inside that virtual world that's running a computer?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Or would you want to know the truth of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, actually, I think that's a very different question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There's actually a moral, ethical question there about whether you should allow a bunch

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of people to get manipulated and killed and enslaved because in The Matrix, they're all

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: enslaved as like a AAA battery to turn a human being into the battery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think the moral and ethical question of that, fascinating enough, isn't actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: different than the moral and ethical questions we face today in modern daily life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But I probably have given the choice of just completely going along or going against it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I would probably go against it if I had to make this kind of binary choice because going

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: along with it, I think at that scale of scary stuff happening to people is probably something

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: really, really, really difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But for your individual life, it's way more fun to go along with it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you're saying you value the opposing a system that includes the suffering of others

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: versus just for yourself enjoying the ride.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If there is such a binary choice, why choose the opposite system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think it's the nature of the ethical dilemma that you face in that situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This is obviously not something that's happening now, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We don't know this, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We don't know this, but at the end of the day, at that scale of something like that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: happening, yeah, that scale of people being manipulated and harmed, then I think pretty

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: much almost all people have an obligation to go against it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Probably that's what that looks like in my opinion.

body.input: world work this way because they think they're already in that world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But then things like Robinhood make it immediately painfully clear that that's not how the world

body.input: works so that the second real property of DeFi is control, which means that you control

body.input: your assets, not a bank, not a broker, not a third party, you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You control your Bitcoins, you control your tokens in the finance protocol.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you don't like how something's going in that protocol, you can remove it.

body.input: You can send it to another protocol or you can use a feature of the protocol to do something

body.input: it's supposed to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And guess what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You can just say, oops, that feature that isn't so good for my friends over here, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: feature is actually, we're just going to pause that feature in the critical moment when you

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: need it to execute your strategy, which is why you took all the risk to begin with.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then the final reason, the final thing to know about DeFi is that DeFi is inherently

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: global and actually right now provides better yield globally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So if you go to a bank right now with the US dollar, you get 1% or less.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you go to DeFi with the US dollar, you get 7% or 8%.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So if we think about that in a world where there's a lot of inflation coming down the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of control that you see in Robinhood, and people are more and more concerned about both

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: what DeFi is about in a practical sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It is this clarity about your risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It is control over your assets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And amazingly, at the same time as having those two unbelievably useful properties,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it is actually superior yield, which just leads me to the very obvious conclusion that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the only reason DeFi isn't more used is because more people don't know about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And by virtue of this long explanation here and elsewhere, more people will know about

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that transparency gives control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Transparency creates accountability and there's this kind of game being played, game theoretic

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: game, where if I know, if you know I'm going to discover your deviation, you're not going

body.input: to deviate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This could be a whole nother conversation, but just as a small aside on the social network

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I tend to believe that human beings, if they're given clear transparency about which

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think that couple together can create a very different kind of world and create

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: an incentivization that will lead to progress and innovation and just a much better social

body.input: network and a really good business for the future social networks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I tend to see control as naturally being an odd growth from the transparency.

body.input: to people on the psychological element, there's a hunger amongst people for transparency and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: for control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Like transparency, another word for that is authenticity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you look at the kind of stuff that people hunger for now, they want to know the reality

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of who you are as an individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So that means you can create businesses, you can create tools that are built on authenticity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: a transparency.

body.input: If you give them control, if you give them power, that they would make good choices.

body.input: So a couple of that, there's a hunger for transparency so that we can move to a world

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So those two coupled together is really, to me, inspiring.

body.input: Just to really quickly comment on the stuff that you just said, which I think is super,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: super, super fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think that's all exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think everything that you said is right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think it's actually going to be the same for social media and banking and every

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: other type of contract is that all of those systems that house people's value for them

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and take control of either their social media value or their financial value or whatever

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: for them, all of that is going to be made available to people in like this autonomous

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So they get all the features, but the autonomous piece of code gives them the ability to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: control while getting all the features.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So banks give you features, social media sites give you features, you know, whatever other

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: system that you use online gives you features.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then it takes your data and it takes control of your assets from you in return for those

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: features.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think the whole big difference here, partly in line with the definition of smart contracts

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and its evolution, is that there's this autonomous piece of code that's giving you all those

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: features without requiring the ownership and lock-in and control and unilateral kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: ownership of your data or your value or whatever it is that you're giving it.

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think what this will lead to fundamentally is just more of a free market dynamic among

body.input: or something where you can just export all your data from them.
