body.input: application that you control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And there will just be thousands of different interfaces competing for how to consume all

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the social media data because it isn't locked in and one centralized actor's control.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so this is just the recurring pattern of what I think all of this will do is it

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: gives people a better deal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And it gives people the features without ownership of data, without ownership of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's really the difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think this is a good place to talk about smart contracts then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Can you tell me the history of smart contracts and the basic definitions of what is it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think smart contracts as a definition has actually gone through some kind of changes

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: or small evolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Initially, I think it was actually a conception of a digital agreement that was tamper-proof

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and could know things about the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So it could get proof and it could define that something happened and it could conclude

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: an outcome and release payment or do something else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's actually the definition of smart contracts that I began working in this industry with

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: seven or eight years ago when I started making smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That is the conception that I had of a smart contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Then what happened was that was really hard to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Building that type of tamper-proof digital agreement that could also know things about

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the real world and release payments back to people about those events that were codified

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in this tamper-proof format was actually a very tall order.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Turns out it's consistent of three parts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's consisting of the contract, the proof about what happened, and the release of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: The way things have evolved so far is that the definition has now come to mean on-chain

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So it's come to mean the codification of contractual agreement on a blockchain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's a code somewhere on some blockchain that defines what the agreement is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Now that eliminates the part of the definition that's related to knowing things about the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: world and it partly eliminates the definition about payments and stuff like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But basically it's on-chain code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We in our recent work on a second white paper have actually put out a different definition

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that we call hybrid smart contracts that actually tries to go back to the initial definition

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that I started with seven or eight years ago, which basically says that there's some proof

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: somewhere that's proven to the contract and the contract can know that and the contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: can gain proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Then it can use that proof to settle the agreement that's codified on a blockchain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you both need a mechanism to provide proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You need a mechanism to codify the contract in a tamper-proof way on something like a

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: blockchain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then as with all contracts, there's a presumption that there's some kind of release

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think a smart contract in our industry right now means on-chain code, which limits

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it to whatever can be done on-chain only.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then in our internal definition for us, and for us at Chainlink and for me, it's hybrid

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: smart contracts, which is actually the original definition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's the idea that a contract can both know what happened and automatically resolve to

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the proper outcome based on what happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you're referring to the Chainlink 2.0 white paper, which is a paper that I recommend people

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: look.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's a very easy read and very well structured and very thorough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I really enjoyed it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Very recently released, I guess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Can you dig in deeper?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What is a hybrid smart contract?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You mentioned sort of this idea of data or knowing about the world and on-chain and off-chain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So what are the different roles in this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So hybrid, by the way, refers to the fact that it's on-chain and off-chain contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So maybe digging deeper of what the heck is it and what does it mean to know stuff about

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Like, how do you actually achieve that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yeah, absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So the on-chain part is where the agreement itself is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's the smart contract itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's where you codify certain conditions such as the conditions under which an interest

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: payment is made or the conditions under which the contract pays out the full amount that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it holds to someone based on a derivative outcome or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Now what the on-chain code is very good at is creating transparency about what the core

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: conditions of the contract are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's very good at taking in money from other private keys that send it tokens and send

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it value to hold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then it's also very good at returning money or returning value back to other addresses

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: or other private keys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It can also be involved in governance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It can be involved in a few other private key signature based operations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But primarily the on-chain part of a hybrid smart contract, from what I've seen so far,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: defines the agreement, takes in value, and returns value based upon the conditions codified

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in the agreement on a blockchain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: The second and equally important off-chain part is where the term and oracle comes in

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: or an oracle mechanism or a decentralized oracle network as we describe it in the paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And this is another decentralized computational system that has a different goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So blockchains have the goal of packaging transactions into blocks and connecting them

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in a cryptographically unique way to create security and assurance about that chain of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: transactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oracles and decentralized oracle networks achieve consensus and they achieve decentralization

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: about the topic of what happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So blockchains structure transactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Some of those transactions might be the state changes in different pieces of on-chain code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then those on-chain pieces of code require input.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think the thing that people get kind of a little bit thrown by is despite being called

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: smart contracts, the on-chain code on a blockchain cannot actually speak to any other system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So blockchains are valuable and useful as far as they're tamper-proof and secure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And to be tamper-proof and secure, they're made this kind of walled garden that is able

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to know and interact only with the highly reliable information that's within that system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: which is basically tokens and private key signatures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: All the other world's information is not available in a blockchain inherently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And a smart contract or a piece of on-chain code can't just say, hey, I'm going to go

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: get some data from over here because the API they would get it from creates a whole bunch

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of security concerns for the blockchain itself and a whole bunch of consensus issues about

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: how to agree on what that API said or what the truth of the world is, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because it's not even agreeing on what one API said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's more so creating a reliable form of decentralized computation that can give you a definitive

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: proof of what happened and not just what one API said.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So for example, some of our most widely used networks have well over 30 nodes and well

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: over 10 data sources that are all providing information about the same type of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then there's consensus on that one piece of data, which is then written in and essentially

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: given back into the on-chain code to tell it what happened.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because you can't really make an agreement unless you know what happened, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you and me were to make an agreement and set some contractual conditions, but our agreement

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: could never know what happened, it would be completely useless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: However, if you and me made an agreement and there was another system called an oracle

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: mechanism or decentralized oracle network that proved what happened definitively, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: you and me pre-agreed that whatever this mechanism says is what happened, then we can achieve

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: an entirely new level of automation, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We can suddenly say there's this piece of on-chain code that's highly reliable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We can give it millions, billions, eventually trillions of dollars in value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And it is controlled by this other system over here that's also highly reliable under

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: this configurable set of definitive truth and decentralization conditions, which we

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: all agree are sufficiently stringent to control that much value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And therefore, the combination of this tamper-proof on-chain representation of a contract and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: this mutually agreed upon definition of a trigger or a proof system combined is a hybrid

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: smart contract, which as you can see probably already does a lot more than just a contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: on-chain, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Can you talk about this consensus mechanism, which by the way is just fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So there is the on-chain consensus mechanism of proof of work and proof of stake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then there is this oracle network consensus mechanism of what is true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So how do you, can you compare the two?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: How do you achieve that kind of consensus?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: How do you achieve security in integrating data about the world in a way that's definitively

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: true, in a way that is usefully true such that we can rely on it in making major agreements

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that as you said involve billions of trillions of dollars?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So this is the challenging question, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This is the challenging problem that oracle networks, oracles, we at Chainlink that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: work on in order to create this definitive truth to trigger and create hyper automation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in this more advanced form, more advanced form of hybrid smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: The reality I think of this problem is that it is very specific to each use case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And this is actually how we've architected our system is in a very flexible way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So for example, you need an ability for an oracle network to grow in the amount of nodes

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that it has relative to the value it secures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So if you have an oracle network that secures $100,000 in like a beta of a financial product,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: maybe it can be fine with only seven nodes and only two or three data sources, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because the risk to that oracle network is relatively low based on the value it secures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So the first question is actually how do you scale security relative to value secured by

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that oracle network?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because it wouldn't be very efficient to have a thousand nodes securing $100,000 worth of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So one of the first questions is how do we properly scale and how do we compose ensembles

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of nodes in a decentralized way where we can know that, okay, we're going from seven nodes

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in a network to 15, to 31, to 57, to 105, to 1,000, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So that's one dimension of the problem.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you have to be scaling the number of nodes relative to the value that's derived from

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the truth integrated into those nodes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, that's not the only problem, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: The other side of this is that you're trying to create a deterministic result, a deterministic

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: output from a set of non-deterministic disparate systems, data sources, or places that prove

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Can you also just as a side, what is an oracle node?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What is the role of an oracle node?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So an oracle node essentially exists in both places.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It exists in both worlds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It exists as an on-chain contract that represents either an oracle network or an oracle node.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So there's an on-chain interface in the form of a contract that says, I exist to give you

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: this list of inputs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You can request weather data from me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You can request price data from me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You can ask me to send a payment somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Like an API.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So it's a pointer to API that provides truth about this world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's an interface.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So just like an API is an interface for Web 2.0 engineers, oracle networks and the contracts

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that represent them or individual nodes are the interface of Web 3.0's use of services.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And services includes all services.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Data, payment systems, messaging systems, whatever Web 2.0 or any kind of computing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: service that you can conceptualize needs an interface on-chain in the form of a contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that says, here are the services I can provide for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Here are the transactions you need to send me to get back this data or that computation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: or this result.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then what you actually see is that the centralized oracle networks, because they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: uniquely capable of generating their own computations in a decentralized way around the data that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: they have access to, you actually see decentralized oracle networks generating a lot of data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: About these services.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So for example, we have a randomness service, a verifiable randomness function service that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: basically provides randomness on-chain and that randomness is then used in lotteries

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and various other contracts that need randomness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But that randomness, it's not a piece of data that comes from somewhere else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We don't go to another data source and get it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We generate it within an oracle node that then provides it over into oracle node or

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: oracle nodes that provided into the contracts themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So why do you say oracle nodes are non-deterministic?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well they are as far as they come to consensus, but there's this kind of different problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: here, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: The blockchains are very focused on generating blocks of transactions within a smaller universe

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of transaction types, a certain block size and a certain set of conditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then they have an economic system that says, I will perpetually generate blocks of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: this size with these transaction types in this kind of limited set of transaction types,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: whether those are UTXO transactions or scripted, Solidi or whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oracles and oracle networks, we don't have a blockchain, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There is no chain link blockchain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Our goal is not to generate a certain set of very clearly predetermined transaction

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: types into a set of transactions that are put into blocks and will infinitely be done

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Our goal is actually to create what we call a meta layer, a decentralized meta layer between

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the non-deterministic, highly unreliable world and the highly hyper reliable world of blockchains

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: so that the unreliable world can be passed through this decentralized meta layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It can coexist with the reliable on-chain world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It can coexist and in some cases the meta layer might generate it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So the problem in giving you this straight answer is that there's just such a wide array

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of services.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If you were to say, well, Sergey, how do we generate randomness from a data source?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, we don't use a data source to generate the randomness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's the type of service that can be generated in an oracle network itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so there will be certain computations that oracle networks themselves generate themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to augment and improve blockchains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And it is actually the goal of oracles to consistently do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So if you were to think about the stack in a very generic high level, you would see blockchains

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: are databases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They're basically the data structures that retain a lot of information in this transparent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: highly reliable form.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Smart contract code is the application logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It is the logic under which all of this kind of activity occurs, storing data in the data

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: structure in the blockchain as a database in a certain conceptualization of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then oracles and oracle networks are all the services that are used by the application

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So by analogy, let's take Uber.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Uber, initially, some core code goes and gets the GPS API from Google Maps about the user's

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: location, sends a message to the user through Twilio, pays the driver through Stripe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If those services weren't available to the people who made Uber, they wouldn't have made

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Uber, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because they would have written their core code on some database, and then they would

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: have had to make a geolocation company, a telecom messaging company, and the global

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: payments company.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And they wouldn't have done that because it's too hard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's the weird scenario that a lot of people in our industry are in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's the problem that oracles and oracle networks fix, is they provide these decentralized

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: services to take this developer ecosystem, the blockchain and smart contract developer

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: ecosystem from, hey, I can have a database and write some application logic about tokenization

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and voting and private key signing, all of which is super useful and is a critical foundation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But now, if you just layer on all the world's services, whether that's market data, weather

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: data, randomness, suddenly people can build DeFi, fraud-proof gaming, fraud-proof global

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: trade, fraud-proof ad networks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's why this world of decentralized services and decentralized oracle networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: is particularly, in my opinion, important to our industry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yeah, it's funny, you talk about that the current sort of decentralized world, DeFi,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: but decentralized services world is primarily just tokens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And it's basically just financial transactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And the kind of thing, the reason why it's super exciting, the kind of thing you're doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: with Chainlink and oracle networks is that you can basically open up the whole world

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of services to this kind of decentralized smart contract world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I mean, you're talking about just orders of magnitude greater impact financially and just

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: socially and philosophically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Are there interesting near-term and long-term applications that excite you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yeah, there's a lot that excites me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that is how I think about it, that it's not just about we made a decentralized oracle

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's about we made a decentralized service or collection of services that's going from

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: hundreds to thousands, and then people are able to build the hybrid smart contracts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: which I think will redefine what our industry is about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because for example, for the people that only learned about blockchains through the lens

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of NFTs, they understand blockchains through NFTs, not through speculative tokens or Bitcoins.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think that will continue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think the use cases that excite me, they vary between the developed market, the developed

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: world's economies and emerging markets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think in the developed world, what you will see is that transparency, creating a new level

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of information for how markets work and the risk that is in markets and the dynamics that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: put the global financial system at systemic financial risk like 2008.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And my hope is that all of this infrastructure will soften the boom and bust cycles by making

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: information immediately available to all market participants, which is by the way what all

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: market participants want, except for the very, very, very small minority that are able to

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: game the system and their benefit and benefit from booms but avoid busts because of their

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: asymmetric access to information, which really everybody should have and which this technically

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: solves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think in the process of doing that, and which is happening I think right about now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: you see a polishing of the technology such that it can be made available to emerging

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: markets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: On a personal level, I feel that the emerging markets will benefit much more from this technology

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: just like the emerging markets benefit much more from the internet or from those $50 Android

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: phones that people can have because it's such a massive shift in how people's lives work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I have always had access to books and a library, which has been fantastic and very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But there are places in the world where people don't have libraries, but now they have the

body.input: watch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I mean, that's kind of mind blowing realistically, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They just went from zero to one in a very, very dramatic way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think all of these smart contracts, and in my case, I think the one that I seem to

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This is the nature of why it's sometimes hard to see the full value of what our industry

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: does because it solves all these kinds of backend problems that we don't have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Crop insurance is if I own a farm and it doesn't rain, I get an insurance payout, so I don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: need to close down my farm because if it didn't rain, I don't have crops.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: People in the developed world can get crop insurance and there's all kinds of systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that basically pay them out and then they can argue with the insurance company if they

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: don't get paid out properly and whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This allows people to smooth out risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: In fact, a lot of the global options markets were about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They were initially about people selling their produce or their crops ahead of time so that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: if there was a risk of drought, they weren't impacted by it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's where a lot of options trading and all this kind of stuff came from, even though

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it's now turned into this kind of global casino.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But in the emerging market, there are literally people that if they don't have rain for two

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: seasons, they need to close down their farm and become a migrant worker of some kind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And now they have a $50 Android phone where they can read Wikipedia, but they're still

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: because the levels of fraud and the ability to resolve that fraud through courts would

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: just not exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So now these people have to wait for decades to have this very basic form of financial

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: protection or something like a bank account even.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And with this technology, they don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So with this technology, if I have a $50 Android phone and the smart contract has data from

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And guess what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I just leapfrogged past my corrupt government not being able to provide a legal infrastructure

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to create insurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I just leapfrogged past dealing with insurance companies that will probably price gouge me

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: out and often not pay out.

body.input: And I leapfrogged into the world of hyper reliable kind of guaranteed smart contract

body.input: parts of the world have.

body.input: And this type of dynamic for the emerging markets of creating a way for people to control
