metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Which, by the way, could be possible, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If there's enough demand, then the service would be created that has drones flying around

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that's telling you about the colors of all this kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So if there's actual demand, that will be created.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because there'll be value to connect that data feed to the smart contracts and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think you have it unbelievably right because there are already insurance companies that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: use drones to monitor construction sites from overhead and see how many people are wearing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: hard hats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If the percentage of people wearing hard hats isn't sufficiently high, then the policy is

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: voided.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So in that case, there is a data source and that data source can be put into a hybrid

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: smart contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So the limitation of hybrid smart contracts is, is there a data source or a set of data

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: sources to create definitive truth, to settle the contract and eliminate ambiguity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then, as you said, I think as people realize that smart contracts are a format in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: they can form agreement about things like that insurance product around how many people

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: are wearing hard hats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: If I'm the construction site owner, well, I would really like a guarantee that your

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: insurance policy is going to pay me out if everyone is wearing hard hats.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And in that case, there is demand for the data and people will generate the data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I actually think the insurance industry is interestingly a precursor of this because

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: they're so data driven.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You already see insurance companies paying IoT companies to put data into their customer's

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: infrastructure at the cost of the insurance company to generate the data that the insurance

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: company uses to make a policy for the customer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you basically already have people who really want to price data into their agreements when

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: they're of sufficiently high value paying for their own customers to get data sensors

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: into their infrastructure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think as smart contracts become more of a requested format or data driven contracts

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: become more of a format, there will be a growing demand about proving what happened through

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So it'll be motivating totally new data feeds being created.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: By the way, the insurance industry broadly, the revolutions there will be huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I've worked quite a bit with autonomous vehicles, semi-autonomous and just vehicles in general.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: The insurance industry that by the way makes a huge amount of money but is using very crappy

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: data feeds, revolutionizing how, not by crappy I mean very crude.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Literally the insurance is based on things like age, basic demographic information as

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: opposed to really high resolution information about you as an individual, which you may

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: or may not want to provide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you can choose from an individual perspective to provide a data feed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And there the power of insurance to enable the individual, to empower the individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: could be huge because ultimately smart contracts motivate the use of data, the creation of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: new data feeds, but leveraging the whatever service it provides in truth as opposed to

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: some kind of very loose notion of who you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So that, again, not sure how that would change things, but in terms of the fundamental experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of life, because I think we all rely on insurance, not just in business, but in life and grounding

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that insurance and more and more accurate representation of reality might just have

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: transformative effects on society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, just to mention one quick thing that you said where I noticed another trust issue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: you said the user might not want to share their data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So what you could actually do and what we've already worked on is you can have a smart

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: contract that holds the data and evaluates the data of the user without sharing it with

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the insurance companies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And the insurance company knows that the smart contract will evaluate it according to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: policy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They don't need the data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And the user can provide the data knowing it'll never touch the insurance company because

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it's only provided to the smart contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And suddenly you've solved another trust issue because the autonomous piece of code can evaluate

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: information separately from the interests of both of the counterparties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so this is the recurring theme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think you're seeing this recurring theme where there's a trust issue, people can't

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: use a system, they can't collaborate, they can't share information that would make a

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: better agreement for both of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They can't solve a risk in their daily life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They can't participate in a market.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They can't have a bank account because nobody will give it to them because they can't give

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it to them in that legal system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And once you have an autonomous piece of code that can also know what's going on, thanks

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to Oracle networks and that combination of the code and the Oracle network for the hybrid

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: smart contract, the same pattern just recurs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's really the same pattern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And this is why I keep saying trust issues.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's because basically almost every contractual trust issue that I see where there is a piece

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of data to prove and settle the trust issue in a way that works for both parties, there

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: is no reason not to use an autonomous, highly reliable contract and piece of code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I have to tell you, I've seen this in a lot of different industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I've seen it in insurance, ad networks, global finance, global trade.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Those are all multi-trillion dollar industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then there are other smaller industries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Even one of the first smart contracts we worked on many years ago was for search engine optimization

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: firms where they would tell you, hey, I'm going to raise your search engine ranking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Give me the money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And people wouldn't want to give them the money because they never knew if they were

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: going to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then the search engine firm doesn't want to do any work thinking they'll never get

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: any money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So we just initially even came up with a system where you could put Bitcoin into a smart contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and it would be released based on whether the search rank of a website got to a certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: level on Google for a certain keyword.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so the trust problem was solved.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But it's just the same story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's kind of like trust issues around AI, trust issues around financial products, trust

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: issues around insurance, trust issues around social media, whatever it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think that's what people looking at this industry really need to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And once they do understand, they realize what this is all about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: This is about redefining how everyone collaborates with everyone about everything where we can

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: prove something through data.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You've mentioned confidentiality and privacy, that the parties don't need to necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: know private data in this interaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You talk about confidentiality in the white paper for Chainlink 2.0.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Can you talk more about how to achieve confidentiality in this process?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Sure, sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think you once again need to think of the contract as existing in two parts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You have the on-chain code and then you have this off-chain system called the Centralized

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oracle Network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So the question is really what portion of the contract should live in what part of these

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: two systems, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So if you want to create transparency, you should put more information on-chain because

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that's what blockchains are very good at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They're public, transparent, but they don't necessarily have privacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, you can see how those two things are a little bit kind of completely diametrically

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: opposed, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I do think and I do see blockchains working on on-chain encrypted smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's very inefficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It has a lot of nuances around it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That I think will appear at some point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think until it appears, you have an option of taking a part of the computation and putting

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it into the Centralized Oracle Network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We actually did an entire paper about this that we presented at Stanford in February

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of last year, something called Mixicles, which basically talks about how you can take an

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oracle Network and you can put a portion of the computation into the Oracle Network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: assuming that you're comfortable with that limited set of nodes knowing what the computation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: is, and you can actually provide additional confidentiality through special hardware called

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: trusted execution environments that all those nodes are forced to run so they won't even

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: know what they're operating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so at the end of the day, if you look at a hybrid smart contract as gaining functionality

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: from its on-chain code and gaining other functionality from its off-chain, the Centralized Oracle

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Network component, you can place the part of the computation that you would like to

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: be private in the Centralized Oracle Network because you can control the set of nodes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You can control the committee of nodes and you can require that they run certain hardware

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to keep the information private.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So you could basically make a derivative or a binary option is the example used in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Mixicles paper where the payout happened on chain, but it was actually impossible to tell

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: what the outcome of the contract was.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So the outcome of the contract was computed in the Centralized Oracle Network and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: there was a switch that triggered who received the payment, but from the point of view of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: analyzing the on-chain transactions and seeing who received the payment or what the outcome

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of the contract was, you couldn't derive that, you couldn't backward engineer what that was,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: but the users of that hybrid smart contract still had on-chain code that guaranteed them

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that as long as the Centralized Oracle Network found a certain outcome, determined a certain

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: outcome that the relevant user would get paid and there was still a place to put value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So there is this kind of fundamental tension between confidentiality, privacy, which is

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: very important for many contracts, which is critical to many contracts, and the public

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and transparent nature of blockchains, which I think eventually will be solved through

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: encrypted on-chain smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That'll take some time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think that'll take years in my opinion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And before we arrive there, I think people will put the private portion into the Centralized

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oracle Network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Once again, going back to what the Centralized Oracle Networks do, they seek to provide these

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: services.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: secured and decentralized infrastructure-powered, how do we evolve into that world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Well, at the end of the day, it comes down to consensus, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: A collection of independent nodes, a collection of provably independent computing systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: arriving at the same conclusion impartially.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That conclusion might be the transaction is valid between address A and address B. Address

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: A has one Bitcoin, wants to send it to address B, and address B has one Bitcoin, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's one degree of validation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It has certain cryptographic primitives that are used, certain levels of cryptography,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: encryption, and other methods that basically provide clarity and those guarantees.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But fundamentally, it's this level of consensus that multiple independent computing systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: came to the same conclusion, verified that conclusion, and created a sense of finality,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: created a final state that is globally considered to be the state of a transaction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That is how it's achieved, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's achieved by users looking at these mathematical contract systems and saying, if I have money

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: in a bank, there's one single person who controls that money, that's the bank.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: They could choose to give me my money or choose not to give me my money.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's great, but maybe there's a percentage of what I own that I want to put into another

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: system where there's thousands of independent computing systems that are promising me, with

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the help of cryptographic primitives, that I will be able to always have access to this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Whatever this is, whatever this token is, I will at least, or at the very least, I will

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: always have unfettered complete control and access to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's one example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Another example is, hey, we have a hybrid smart contract for something like crop insurance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I as the user evaluate where this smart contract runs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oh, wow, this smart contract runs on Ethereum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Thousands of nodes, lots of computational security, hash power, so on and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Then I look at, oh, well, what triggers the contract?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Oh, there's this Oracle network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Okay, it's composed of 25 nodes or 15 nodes, gets data from five different weather stations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You know, I'm comfortable with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I have a certain level of comfort with that hybrid smart contract and its ability to provide

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: me consensus about the transaction once the contract knows what's happened, and I'm comfortable

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: with the consensus around the event that controls the contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because once again, that event is what determines what happens with the contract, and if the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: contract is super well written, it doesn't matter if the event isn't reliable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So now I've made this determination, I've gotten all this clear, transparent information

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: about this system that combines the contract code with a decentralized Oracle network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and I've made my decision to participate in this decentralized insurance, kind of crop

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: insurance policy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I've sent the Bitcoin or the stablecoin or whatever I have on my Android phone, and then

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: time goes by and let's say it doesn't rain, lo and behold, the smart contract returns

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the relevant amount from the policy back to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I continue my life as a farmer, and by the way, the fact that that happened contributes

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: reputation and contributes proof back to both the contract as something that can prove to

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: other people that it has settled and the Oracle network as something that can prove that it

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: has properly assessed reality or properly triggered a contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And this is where there's one of many network effects where the more that smart contracts

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and Oracle networks are used, they themselves generate this immutable on-chain data that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: proves their value and reliability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And improving more and more of that in more and more kind of use cases and more and more

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: variants of the same contract, they arrive at a greater body of proof that they...

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I am the decentralized insurance contract for crop insurance used by a million users.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And my failure rate is nonexistent or really low.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And here's my Oracle network.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And by the way, it's also settled a million of these.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's much more, hey, there's a million people, there's a million separate contracts that

body.input: got settled correctly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I have all the proof that I could ever need about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so I think once again, the transparency aspect comes in where you're able to prove

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But just to be clear, I am not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And whoever it is, I think they haven't said anything because they don't want the attention

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and they don't want the distraction and they don't want all the problems from this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that makes sense to me conceptually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It's fascinating to think if they're still out there and part of the Bitcoin, the cryptocurrency

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And it is inspiring to think that if they're out there, that they're not revealing their

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: identity because it would be a distraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's kind of inspiring that people are like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Just like George Washington, relinquishing power is inspiring because it's ultimately

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: about the progress of the community, not some kind of ego driven attention scheme.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Again, very inspiring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Humans at their best are inspiring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What do you think about the certainty that people in the Bitcoin maximalist community

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: have about this particular piece of technology, Bitcoin?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Is there something interesting that you think that you might want to say about this community

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: or is it just is what it is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think at the end of the day, results speak for themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And Bitcoin has had an amazing impact on our industry and has had an amazing impact on

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think the result is still that Bitcoin is very widely adopted and driving the adoption

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of our industry in many ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think it's very difficult for people to say that Bitcoin maximalists don't have

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: something that they can latch onto and say, hey, there's something very real here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think there's been decisions made by the Bitcoin community and the people who made

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the Bitcoin protocol to focus it on Bitcoin and to focus it on the kind of storing of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the ledger of Bitcoin and the information about Bitcoin and the transaction of Bitcoin

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and to focus on securing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I understand why that decision was made to a certain degree, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It was about focus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It was about getting something worthwhile, right, without adding additional features

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and additional risk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that decision is a decision that was made and has kind of the benefits of focus and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: the benefits of a certain amount of security and a certain amount of guarantees around

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Bitcoin and what that is and the value of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then it has certain limitations as a consequence of doing less or having the system hold data

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that isn't related to Bitcoin or not having the system hold contractual outcomes or smart

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: contract code.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I think it's just kind of a decision, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I understand why they're excited and I'm very excited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I started in this industry going to Bitcoin meetups and I met a lot of fantastic people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: libertarian people that wanted to see the world work differently and shared a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: my beliefs and a lot of my points of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so, you know, anyone who's been in the industry as long as I have has had to come

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: from the Bitcoin ecosystem by virtue of kind of starting out that early.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I have an unbelievable amount of respect and admiration and gratitude for Bitcoin and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that it exists and everything that it's done and that it birthed this industry.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There's absolutely no doubt about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You know, at the same time, whatever design decisions people make are the design decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: they make, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And so if you've made a design decision that this ledger and this thing will be about Bitcoin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: it won't be about colored coins, it won't be about op return at 80 bytes, it won't be

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: about these other kind of nuances that you don't want this to be about, then that's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's fine and that's a logical decision and that's called focus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And focus has a lot of value and a lot of great technology products have focused on

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: something and done that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then there's a lot of smart people around Bitcoin building kind of additional systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that anchor their security within Bitcoin.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think that's an interesting approach that could bear fruit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think it'll eventually require an interaction with the Bitcoin protocol in more advanced

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And then there will be another question of, you know, what is the design decision for

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Bitcoin?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Is it that Bitcoin will be just about the Bitcoin ledger or does Bitcoin want to evolve

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: into an anchor for all these other systems and maybe create additional data store, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: know, kind of more data on chain on the Bitcoin blockchain related to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So I'm excited to see how that evolves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: But until then, kind of results speak for themselves and the results that Bitcoin has

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: achieved for our industry and for itself as, you know, kind of the dominant cryptocurrency

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and the conception of our industry that people interact with first is obviously very important

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and something that I think really everybody in our industry is grateful for, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because without Bitcoin, where would our industry be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And that's obviously something that we can't forget.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What are your thoughts about Ethereum in the chain link distributed Oracle network world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Is it competition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Is it collaboration?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Is it complementary technology?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What do you think about Ethereum?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: How much do you think about Ethereum?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: What role does it have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Yeah, I think about a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think it's complete, we're completely complementary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So there's no competitive dynamics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: In my opinion, we are completely collaborative and complementary with Ethereum and all other

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: blockchains and all other layer twos that operate a contract, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So we do not seek to operate a smart contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We seek to augment and enable smart contracts to go further in what they're able to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: In fact, Oracle networks have some value, but they don't have nearly as much value in

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: what they do if there isn't a mission critical system like a smart contract that needs their

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: data, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So we've made our own explicit design decisions and created our own focus around guaranteeing

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: that smart contracts can go further.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We've already done that, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Decentralized finance, the rate at which we put data is to a degree the rate at which

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: certain decentralized financial markets grow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And as we put more data, we see more financial products go live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Gaming, we provide VRF.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So we have this kind of focus and it's a very useful and valuable kind of valuable for our

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: industry focus.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: At the end of the day, I think that smart contract platforms like Ethereum made a different

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: set of design decisions from Bitcoin and others, and they focused on creating the smart contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: capability and they kind of wanted that functionality to exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: And I think since then, there's been a number of people that try to improve on that or try

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to make variants of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: From our point of view, we want to support smart contracts in all of their variations

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and in all of their use cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: So one of the things that I personally like about Chainlink is their ability or Chainlink's

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: ability and the Chainlink Network's ability to be useful to many different chains and

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: across many different use cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I'm personally a fan of Ethereum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Ethereum has done a huge amount for our industry as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Ethereum took us from a world where it literally took months to make a new smart contract by

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: being forced to code it into a protocol.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: You had to go to the protocol developers and you had to say, hey, I need a DEX or I need

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: some kind of smart contract.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Put it in the protocol itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Put it in the actual blockchain mining and kind of block generation, transaction generation

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: protocol.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That would take months or sometimes even over a year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That was a horrible experience and obviously very few people wanted to participate in that

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: and so very few people made smart contracts, which I was not a fan of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Then Ethereum came along and really did a lot of innovative things and introduced this

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: approach to scriptable smart contracts where you could script all of these different conditions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I found that fascinating before Ethereum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I found that fascinating once Ethereum arrived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I found it fascinating after Ethereum launched and I still find it fascinating.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I'm also very grateful to Vitalik and the Ethereum community and all the core developers

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: there for taking our industry a step further.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think they absolutely deserve a huge amount of credit for taking our industry from it

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: takes months to make a really small smart contract to it takes weeks to make a relatively

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: secure relatively advanced piece of on-chain code that anybody can script and people can

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: do audits on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: That's an unbelievable leap forward for our industry and I'm genuinely grateful to them

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: for that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: I think the next step in line with our body of work is how does that scriptable on-chain

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: code become more advanced in its interaction with all of the systems and events in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: real world, which is in my opinion the final missing piece of the puzzle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: My body of work, the body of work that I'm involved in would not be where it is right

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: now without Bitcoin by any measure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: It wouldn't even be where it is now without Ethereum and the growth in smart contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: development that they've created.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Now what I think is going to happen next is there will be a lot of different smart contract

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: platforms, a lot of different layer twos.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Some of them will be private for enterprise, some of them will be public.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There will be some public winners in certain geographies for maybe regulation reasons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: maybe other reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: There will be other public winners in the larger internet and there will be a number

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: of different people building smart contracts in different languages.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: We are excited and I am excited and the chain link community is excited and basically there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: a lot of, I mean for lack of a better word, excitement in seeing our industry graduate

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: to providing more use cases, more usable hybrid smart contracts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Sergey Nazarov: Chainlink, Smart Contracts, and Oracle Networks | Lex Fridman Podcast #181

body.input: Because once again, it's absolutely amazing that Bitcoin created non-governmental fiat

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124
