metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: So, okay, so then the question is, what does it mean if you have this map?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Okay, so in a sense, this metamathematical space is the infrastructural space of all possible theorems that you could prove in mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: That's the geometry of metamathematics. There's also the geography of mathematics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: That is, where did people choose to live in space? And that's what, for example, exploring the sort of empirical metamathematics of Euclid is doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: You could put each individual human mathematician, you can embed them into that space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: They represent a path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: The little path. Maybe a set of paths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: So like a set of axioms that are chosen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Right. So for example, here's an example of a thing that I realized. So one of the surprising things about, well, the two surprising facts about math.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: One is that it's hard, and the other is that it's doable. Okay. So first question is, why is math hard? You know, you've got these axioms, they're very small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Why can't you just solve every problem in math easily?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Yeah, it's just logic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Right. Yeah. Well, logic happens to be a particular special case that does have certain simplicity to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: But general mathematics, even arithmetic, already doesn't have the simplicity that logic has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: So why is it hard?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Because of computational irreducibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Because what happens is to know what's true. And this is this whole story about the path you have to follow and how long is the path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: And Gödel's theorem is the statement that could be an inf, that the path is not a bounded length. But the fact that the path is not always compressible to something tiny is a story of computational irreducibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: So that's that's why math is hard. Now, the next question is, why is math doable?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Because it might be the case that most things you care about don't have finite length paths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Most things you care about might be things where you get lost in the sea of computational irreducibility and worse undecidability. That is, there's just no finite length path that gets you there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: You know, why is mathematics doable? You know, Gödel proved his incompleteness theorem in 1931.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Most working mathematicians don't really care about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: They just go ahead and do mathematics, even though it could be that the questions they're asking are undecidable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: It could have been that Fermat's last theorem is undecidable. It turned out it had a proof. It's a long, complicated proof.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: The twin prime conjecture might be undecidable. The Riemann hypothesis might be undecidable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: These things might be the axioms of mathematics might not be strong enough to reach those statements.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: It might be the case that depending on what axioms you choose, you can either say that's true or that's not true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: And by the way, Fermat's last theorem, it could be a shorter path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Absolutely. Yeah. So the notion of geodesics in mathematical space is the notion of shortest proofs in mathematical space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: And that's a, you know, human mathematicians do not find shortest paths, nor do automated theorem provers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: But the fact, and by the way, the, I mean, this stuff is so bizarrely connected.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: I mean, if you're into automated theorem proving, there are these so-called critical pair lemmas in automated theorem proving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Those are precisely the branch pairs in our, that in multi-way graphs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Let me just finish on the why mathematics is doable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Oh, yes. The second part. So we know why it's hard. Why is it doable?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Right. Why do we not just get lost in undecidability all the time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Yeah. So, and here's another fact is in doing computer experiments and doing experimental mathematics, you do get lost in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: When you just say, I'm picking a random integer equation, how do I, does it have a solution or not?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Often, it's really, really hard. It's really hard to answer those questions when you just pick them up random from the space of possibilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: But what's, what I think is happening is, and that's a case where you just fell off into this ocean of sort of irreducibility and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: What's happening is human mathematics is a story of building a path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: You started off, you're always building out on this path where you are proving things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: You've got this proof trajectory and you're basically, the human mathematics is the sort of the exploration of the world along this proof trajectory, so to speak.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: You're not just parachuting in from anywhere, you're following Lewis and Clark or whatever. You're actually doing the path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: And the fact that you are constrained to go along that path is the reason you don't end up with a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: Every so often, you'll see a little piece of undecidability and you'll avoid that part of the path.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: But that's basically the story of why human mathematics has seemed to be doable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: It's a story of exploring these paths that are by their nature, they have been constructed to be paths that can be followed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: And so you can follow them further. Now, you know, why is this relevant to anything?

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

body.input: I think there's some sort of connections between the way that observers work in physics and the way that the axiom systems of mathematics are set up to make mathematics be doable in that kind of way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

metadata.title: Podcast: Stephen Wolfram: Fundamental Theory of Physics, Life, and the Universe | Lex Fridman Podcast #124

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In fact, I think consciousness is the ultimate nature of matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So as for whether it's outside of the scientific method, I think there's a fundamental challenge

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: consciousness is not publicly observable.

body.input: I can't look inside your head and see your feelings and experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We just know about it from our immediate awareness of our feelings and experiences.

body.input: So it's qualitative, not quantitative as you talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, that's another aspect of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So there are a couple of reasons consciousness I think is not fully susceptible to the standard

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: scientific approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: One reason you've just raised is that it's qualitative rather than quantitative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Another reason is it's not publicly observable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I mean, science is used to dealing with unobservables, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: observable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But there's an important difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: With all these things, we postulate unobservables in order to explain what we can observe, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In the whole of science, that's how it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In the case of consciousness, in the unique case of consciousness, the thing we are trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to explain is not publicly observable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And that is utterly unique.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They could run the experiments themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whereas consciousness, is it observable?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Is it not observable?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In a sense, it's observable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: As you say, we could say it's privately observable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I am directly aware of my own feelings and experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If I'm in pain, it's just right there for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: My pain is just totally directly evident to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But you from the outside cannot directly access my pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You can access my pain behavior, or you can ask me, but you can't access my pain in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: way that I can access my pain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think that's a distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It might be difficult to totally pin it down how we define those things, but I think there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a fairly clear and very important difference there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You think there's a direct observation that you're able to do of your pain that I'm not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: My observation, all the ways in which I can sneak up to observing your pain is indirect

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: versus yours is direct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Can you play devil's advocate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Is it possible for me to get closer and closer and closer to being able to observe your pain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: like all the subjective experiences, yours in the way that you do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Of course, it's not that we observe behavior and then we make an inference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We are hardwired to instinctively interpret smiles as happiness, crying as sadness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: As we get to know someone, we find it very easy to adopt their perspective, get into

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: their shoes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But strictly speaking, all we have perceptual access to is someone's behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Strictly speaking, if you were trying to explain someone's behavior, those aspects that are

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: publicly observable, I don't think you'd ever have recourse to attribute consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You could just postulate some kind of mechanism if you were just trying to explain the behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Someone like Daniel Dennett is very consistent on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think for most people, what science is in the business of is explaining the data of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: public observation experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If you religiously followed that, you would not postulate consciousness because it's not

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a datum that's known about in that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Daniel Dennett is really consistent on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: He thinks my consciousness cannot be empirically verified and therefore it doesn't exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Dennett is consistent on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think I'm consistent on this, but I think a lot of people have a slightly confused middle

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: way position on this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: On the one hand, they think the business of science is just to account for public observation

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: experiment, but on the other hand, they also believe in consciousness without appreciating,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think, that that implies that there is another datum over and above the data of public observation

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: experiments, namely just the reality of feelings and experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: As we walk along this conversation, you keep opening doors that I want to walk into and

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I will, but I want to try to stay kind of focused.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You mentioned Daniel Dennett, let's lay it out, since he sticks to his story, pun unintended,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and then you stick to yours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What is your story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What is your theory of consciousness versus his?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Can you clarify his position?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: My view, I defend the view known as panpsychism, which is the view that consciousness is a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: fundamental and ubiquitous feature of the physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It doesn't literally mean that everything is conscious despite the meaning of the word

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: pan, everything, psyche, mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So literally that means everything has mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But the typical commitment of the panpsychist is that the fundamental building blocks of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: reality, maybe fundamental particles like electrons and quarks, have incredibly simple

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: forms of experience and that the very complex experience of the human or animal brain is

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: somehow rooted in or derived from this much more simple consciousness at the level of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: fundamental physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So that's a theory that I would justify on the grounds that it can account for this datum

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of consciousness that we are immediately aware of in our experience in a way that I don't

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: think other theories can.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You asked me to contrast that to Daniel Dennett.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think he would just say there is no such datum.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Dennett says the data for science of consciousness is what he calls hetero-phenomenology, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: is specifically defined as what we can access from the third person perspective, including

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: what people say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But crucially, we're not treating what they say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're not relying on their testimony as evidence for some unobservable realm of feelings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're just treating what they say as a datum of public observation experiments that we

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: can account for in terms of underlying mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I feel like there's a deeper view of what consciousness is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So you have a very clear view, and we'll talk quite a bit about panpsychism, but you have

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a clear view of what, almost like a physics view of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: He I think has a kind of view that consciousness is almost a side effect of this massively

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: parallel computation system going on in our brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The brain has a model of the world, and it's taking in perceptions, and it's constantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: weaving multiple stories about that world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That collaborative editing is the actual experience of what we think of as consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Somehow the editing is consciousness of this story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's a theory of consciousness, isn't it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The narrative theory of consciousness, or the multiple versions editing, collaborative

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Can I lose out a bit and I have a bit less pleasure, but I thought it was worth doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the honest thing or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, I just think so that's a, I mean, maybe you can use the word pleasure so broadly

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: that you're just essentially meaning something worthwhile, but then I think the word pleasure

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: maybe loses its meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Well, but what do you think about the blades of grass case?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What do you think about someone who spends their life counting blades of grass and doesn't

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: enjoy it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think, I personally think it's impossible or maybe I'm not understanding even like the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: philosophical formulation, but I think it's impossible to have a goal and not draw pleasure

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Make it worthwhile, forget the word pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think the word goal loses meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If I say I'm going to count the number of pens on this table, if I'm actively involved

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in the task, I will find joy in it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I will find that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like, I think there's a lot of meaning and joy to be discovered in the skill of a task

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in mastering of a skill and taking pride in doing it well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, that's, I don't know what it is about the human mind, but there's some joy to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: discovered in the mastery of a skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think it's just impossible to count blades of grass and not sort of have the gyro dreams

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of sushi compelling, like draws you into the mastery of the simple task.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, I suppose, I mean, in a way you might think it's just hard to imagine someone who

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: would spend their lives doing that, but then maybe that's just because it's so evident

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: that that is a pointless task.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whereas if we take this David Hume view seriously, it ought to be, you know, a totally possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: life goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, I guess I just find it hard to shake the idea that some ways of, some life goals

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: are more worthwhile than others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And it doesn't mean, you know, that there's one single way you should lead your life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: but pursuing knowledge, helping people, pursuing your own pleasure to an extent are worthwhile

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: things to do in a way that, you know, for example, I have, I'm a little bit OCD.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I still feel inclined to walk on cracks in the pavement or do it symmetrically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like if I step on a crack with my left foot, I feel the need to do it with my right foot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think that's kind of pointless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's something I feel the urge to do, but it's pointless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whereas other things I choose to do, I think it's worth doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And it's hard to make sense of metaphysically what could possibly ground that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: How could we know about these facts?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But that's the starting point for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think you walking on the sidewalk in a way that's symmetrical brings order to the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like if you weren't doing that, the world might fall apart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And you-

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It feels like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think there's meaning in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like you embracing the full, like the full experience of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You living the richness of that as if it has meaning will give meaning to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then whatever genius comes of that as you as one little intelligent aunt will make

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a better life for everybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Perhaps I'm defending the blades of grass example, because I can literally imagine myself

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: enjoying this task as somebody who's OCD in a certain kind of way and quantitative.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But now you're ruining the example because you imagine someone enjoying it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I'm imagining someone who doesn't enjoy it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We don't want a life that's just full of pleasure, like we just sit there, you know, having a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: big sugar high all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We want a life where we do things that are worthwhile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If for something to be worthwhile just is for it to be a basic life goal, then that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: mode of reflection doesn't really make sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We can't really think, did I do things worthwhile?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: From the David Hume type picture, all it is for something to be worthwhile is it was a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: basic goal of yours or derived from a basic goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, I think goal and worthwhile aren't, I think goal is a boring word.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I'm more sort of existentialist, like did you ride the roller coaster of life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Did you fully experience life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And in that sense, I mean, the blades of grass is something that could be deeply joyful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In that way, I think suffering could be joyful in the full context of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's the roller coaster of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Without suffering, without struggle, without pain, without depression or sadness, there's

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: not the highs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, that's the fucked up thing about life is that the lows really make the highs that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: much richer and deeper and like tastes better, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like the...

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like I tweeted this, I couldn't sleep and I was like late at night.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I know it's like obvious statement, but like every love story eventually, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: ends in loss, in tragedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So like this feeling of love at the end, there's always going to be tragedy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Even if it's the most amazing lifelong love with another human being, one of you is going

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to die.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I don't know which is worse, but both are not going to be pretty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so that, the sense that it's finite, the sense that it's going to end in a low, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: gives like richness to those kind of evenings when you realize this fucking thing ends,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: this thing ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The feeling that it ends, that bad taste, that bad feeling that it ends gives meaning,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: gives joy, gives pleasure, I don't know, pleasure is this loaded word, but gives some kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: deep pleasure to the experience when it's good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I mean, and that's the blades of grass, you know, they have that to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But you're perhaps right that it's like reducing it to goals or something like that, is kind

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of removing the magic of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Because I think what makes counting the blades of grass joyful is just because it's life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Okay, so it sounds like you reject the David Hume type picture anyway, because you're saying

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: just because you have it as a goal, that's what it is to be worthwhile.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But you're saying, no, it's because it's engaging with life, riding the roller coaster.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So that does sound like in some sense, there are facts independent of our personal goal

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: choices about what it means to live a good life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I mean, coming back full circle to the start of this was what makes us different

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't think at the end of a hamster's life, it thinks, did I ride the roller coaster?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Did I really live life to the full?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That is not a mode of reflection that's available to non-human animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So what do you think is the role of death in all of this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The fear of death?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Does that interplay with consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Does this self-reflection?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Do you think there's some deep connection between this ability to contemplate the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: that our flame of consciousness eventually goes out?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, I don't think, unfortunately, panpsychism helps particularly with life after death,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: because for the panpsychist, there's nothing supernatural.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There's nothing beyond the physical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: All there is really is ultimately particles and fields.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's just that we think the ultimate nature of particles and fields is consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I guess when the matter in my brain ceases to be ordered in a way that sustains the particular

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: kind of consciousness I enjoy in waking life, then in some sense, I will cease to be.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Although the final chapter of my book, Galileo's Era, is more experimental.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The first four chapters are the cold-blooded case for the panpsychist view as the best

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: solution to the hard problem of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The last chapter is where you talk about meaning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, I talk about meaning, I talk about free will, and I talk about mystical experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I always want to emphasize that panpsychism is not necessarily connected to anything spiritual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: A lot of people defending this view, like David Chalmers or Luke Roloff, are just total

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: atheist secularists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They don't believe in any kind of transcendent reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They just believe in feelings, mundane consciousness, and think that needs explaining in our conventional

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: scientific approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Can't cut it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But if for independent reasons you are motivated to some spiritual picture of reality, then

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: maybe a panpsychist view is more consonant with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So if you have a mystical experience where it seems to you in this experience that there

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: is this higher form of consciousness at the root of all things, if you're a materialist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: you've got to think that's a delusion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There's just something in your brain making you think that it's not real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But if you're a panpsychist and you already think the fundamental nature of reality is

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: constituted of consciousness, it's not that much of a leap to think that this higher form

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of consciousness you seem to apprehend in the mystical experience is part of that underlying

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: reality.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In many different cultures, experienced meditators have claimed to have experiences in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: it becomes apparent to them that there is an element of consciousness that is universal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So this is sometimes called universal consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So on this view, your mind and my mind are not totally distinct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Each of our individual conscious minds is built upon the foundations of universal consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Universal consciousness as it exists in me is one and the same thing as universal consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: as it exists in you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I've never had one of these experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But if one is a panpsychist, I think one is more open to that possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't see why it shouldn't be the case that that is part of the nature of consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and maybe something that is apparent in certain deep states of meditation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so what I explore in the experimental final chapter of my book is that could allow

body.input: So I guess probably still the dominant view is materialism, that roughly that we can explain

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: signaling in the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Dualism, the polar opposite view, that consciousness is non-physical outside of the physical workings

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of the body and the brain, although closely connected.

body.input: And when I studied philosophy, we were taught basically they were the two options you had

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to choose, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Either you thought it were dualist and you thought it was separate from the physical,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: or you thought it was just electrochemical signaling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And yeah, I became very disillusioned because I think there are big problems with both of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: these options.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think the attraction to panpsychism is it's kind of a middle way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It agrees with the materialist that there's just a physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Ultimately, there's just particles and fields.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That the panpsychist thinks there's more to the physical than what physical science reveals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and that the ultimate nature of the physical world is constituted of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So consciousness is not outside of the physical, as the dualist thinks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's embedded in, underlies the kind of description of the world we get from physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What are the problems of materialism and dualism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Starting with materialism, it's a huge debate, but I think that the core of it is that physical

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: science works with a purely quantitative description of the physical world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whereas consciousness essentially involves qualities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If you think about the smell of coffee or the taste of mint or the deep red you experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: as you watch a sunset, I think these qualities can't be captured in the purely quantitative

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: language of physical science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So as long as your description of the brain is framed in the purely quantitative language

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of neuroscience, you'll just leave out these qualities and hence really leave out consciousness

body.input: itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then dualism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I've actually changed my mind a little bit on this since I wrote the book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I argued in the book that we have pretty good experimental grounds for doubting dualism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And roughly the idea was if dualism were true, if there was say an immaterial mind impacting

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: on the brain every second of waking life, that this would really show up in our neuroscience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There'd be all sorts of things happening in the brain that had no physical explanation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It would be like a poltergeist was playing with the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so the fact that we don't find that is a strong and ever-growing inductive argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: against dualism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But actually the more I talk to neuroscientists and read neuroscience, and we have at Durham

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But what we're almost clueless on is how those large-scale functions are realized at the cellular

body.input: So I think we'd have to know a lot more about how the brain works, how these functions are

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think it's still the view to be preferred, to put it very simply, why believe in two
