metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of the human or animal brain is somehow rooted in or derived from these very simple forms

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of experience at the level of basic physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I mean, maybe the crucial bit about the kind of panpsychism I defend, what it does

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: is it takes the standard approach to the problem of consciousness and turns it on its head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the standard approach is to think, we start with matter and we think, how do we get consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: out of matter?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I don't think that problem can be solved for reasons I've kind of hinted at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We could maybe go into more detail.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But the panpsychist does it the other way around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They start with consciousness and try to get matter out of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the idea is basically at the fundamental level of reality, there are just networks

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of very simple conscious entities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But these conscious entities, because they have very simple kinds of experience, they

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: behave in predictable ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Through their interactions, they realize certain mathematical structures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then the idea is those mathematical structures just are the structures identified by physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So when we think about these simple conscious entities, in terms of the mathematical structures

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: they realize, we call them particles, we call them fields, we call their properties mass,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: spin and charge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But really, there's just these very simple conscious entities and their experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So in this way, we get physics out of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't think you can get consciousness out of physics, but I think it's pretty easy to

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: get physics out of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Well, I'm a little confused by why you need to get physics out of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: To me, it sounds like panpsychism unites consciousness and physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Physics is the mathematical science of describing everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So physics should be able to describe consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What physics in my understanding proposes is that physics doesn't currently do so, but

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: can in the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It seems like consciousness, you have like Stephen Wolfram, all these people who are

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: trying to develop theories of everything, mathematical frameworks within which to describe

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: how we get all the reality that we perceive around us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: To me, there's no reason why that kind of framework cannot also include some accurate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: precise description of whatever simple consciousness characteristics are present there at the lowest

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: level if panpsychist theories have truth to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So to me, it is physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You said physics emerges by which you mean the basic four laws of physics that as we

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: currently know them, the standard model, quantum mechanics, general relativity, that emerges

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: from the base consciousness layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's what you mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So maybe the way I phrased it made it sound like these things are more separate than they

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What I was trying to address was a common misunderstanding upon psychism that it's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: sort of dualistic theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The idea is that particles have their physical properties like mass, spin, and charge, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: these other funny consciousness properties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the physicist Sabine Hossenfelder had a blog post critiquing panpsychism maybe a couple

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of years ago now that got a fair bit of traction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: She was interpreting panpsychism in this way and then her thought was, well, look, if particles

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: had these funny consciousness properties, then it would show up in our physics like

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the standard model of particle physics would make false predictions because its predictions

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: are based wholly on the physical properties.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If there were also these consciousness properties, we'd get different predictions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But that's a misunderstanding of the view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The view is not that there are two kinds of property, that mass, spin, and charge are

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: forms of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: How do we make sense of that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Because actually when you look at what physics tells us, it's really just telling us about

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: behavior, about what stuff does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I sometimes put it by saying doing physics is like playing chess when you don't care

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: what the pieces are made of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You're just interested in what moves you can make.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So physics tells us what mass, spin, and charge do, but it doesn't tell us what they are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the idea-

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The experience of mass.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the idea is yeah, mass in its nature is a very simple form of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So yeah, physics in a sense is complete, I think, because it tells us what everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: at the fundamental level does, it describes its causal capacities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But for the panpsychist at least, physics doesn't tell us what matter is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It tells us what it does, but not what it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: To push back on the thing I think she's criticizing, is it also possible, so I understand what

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: you're saying, but is it also possible that particles have another property like consciousness?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't understand the criticism we would be able to detect it in our experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Well, no, if you're not looking for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There's a lot of stuff that are orthogonal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If you're not looking for this stuff, you're not going to detect it, because all of our

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: basic empirical science through its recent history, and yes, the history of science is

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: quite recent, has been very focused on billiard balls colliding, and from that understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: how gravity works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But we just haven't integrated other possibilities into this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't think there will be conflicting, whether you are observing consciousness or not, or

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: exploring some of these ideas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't think that affects the rest of the physics, the mass, the energy, all the different

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: kind of hierarchy of different particles and so on, how they interact.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It feels like consciousness is something orthogonal, very much distinct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The quantitative versus the qualitative, there's something quite distinct that we're just almost

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: like another dimension that we're just completely ignoring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There might be a way of responding to Sabina to say, well, that there could be properties

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of particles that don't show up in the specific circumstances in which physicists investigate

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: particles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: My colleague, the philosopher of science, Nancy Cartwright, has got this book, How the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Laws of Physics Lie, where she says physicists explore things in very specific circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and then in an unwarranted way generalize that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I guess I was thinking Sabina's criticism actually just misses the mark in a more basic

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The other point is we shouldn't think there are any more properties to particles other

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: than those, the standard model attributes to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Panpsychus would say, yeah, sure, there aren't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There are just the properties, the physical properties like mass, spin and charge, that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the standard model attributes to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's just that we have a different philosophical view as to the nature of the property.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Those properties of turtles, they're sitting on top of another turtle and that big turtle

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: is consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's what you're saying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I'm just saying, it's possible that's true.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's possible also that consciousness is just another turtle playing with the others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's just not interacting in the ways that we've been observing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In fact, to me, that's more compelling because then that's going to be, well, no, I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: both are very compelling, but it feels like it's more within the reach of empirical validation

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: if it's yet another property of particles that we're just not observing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If it's the thing from which matter and energy and physics emerges, it makes it that much

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: more difficult to investigate how you get from that base layer of consciousness to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: wonderful little spark of consciousness, complexity and beauty that is the human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't know if you're necessarily trying to get there, but one of the beautiful things

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to get at with panpsychism or with a solid theory of consciousness is to answer the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: how do you engineer the thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: How do you get from nothing, vacuum in the lab?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If there is that consciousness base layer, how do you start engineering organisms that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: have consciousness in them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Or the reverse of that describing how does consciousness emerge in the human being from

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: conception, from a stem cell to the whole full neurobiology that builds from that, how

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: do you get this full rich experience of consciousness that humans have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It feels like that's the dream and if consciousness is just another player in the game of physics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: it feels more amenable to our scientific understanding of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, I guess it's supposed to be a kind of identity claim here that physics tells

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: us what matter does, consciousness is what matter is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So matter is sort of what consciousness does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So at the bottom level, there is just consciousness and conscious things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There are just these simple things with their experiences and that is their total nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So in that sense, it's not another player, it's just all there is really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In physics, we describe that at a certain level of abstraction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We capture what Bertrand Russell, who was the inspiration for a lot of this, calls the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: causal skeleton of the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So physics is just interested in the causal skeleton of the world, it's not interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in the flesh and blood, although that's maybe suggesting separation again, too much, all

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: metaphors fail in the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So you're totally right, ultimately what we want to explain is how our consciousness and

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the consciousness of other animals comes out of this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If we can't do that, then it's game over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I think it maybe makes more sense on the identity claim that if matter at the fundamental

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: level just is forms of consciousness, then we can perhaps make sense of how those simple

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: forms of consciousness in some way combine in some way to make the consciousness we know

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's the dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I guess the question is, the reason you can describe, the reason you have material

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: engineering, material science, is because you have from physics to chemistry, you keep

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: going up and up in levels of complexity in order to describe objects that we have in

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: our human world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And it would be nice to do the same thing for consciousness, to come up with the chemistry

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: How do the different particles interact to create greater complexity?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So you can do this kind of thing for life, like what is life?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Like living organisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: At which point do living organisms become living?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: How do you know if I give you a thing that that thing is living?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There's a lot of people working on this kind of idea and some of it has to do with the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: levels of complexity and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It'd be nice to know like measuring different degrees of consciousness as you get into a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: bigger more and more complex objects.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And that's what chemistry, like bigger and bigger conscious molecules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And to see how that leads to organisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then organisms start to collaborate together like they do inside our human body to create

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the full human body.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: To do those kinds of experiments would be, it seems like that would be kind of a goal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's what I mean by player in a game of physics as opposed to like the base layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If it's just the base layer, it becomes harder to track it as you get from physics to chemistry,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to biology, to psychology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In every case, apart from consciousness, I would say what we're interested in is behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're interested in explaining behavioral functions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So at the level of fundamental physics, we're interested in capturing the equations that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: describe the behavior there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And when we get to higher levels, we're interested in explicating the behavior perhaps in terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of behavior at simpler levels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And with life as well, that's what we're interested in, the various observable functions of life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: explaining them in terms of more simple mechanisms.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But in the case of consciousness, I don't think that's what we're doing or at least

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: not all that we're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In the case of consciousness, there are these subjective qualities that we're immediately

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: aware of, the redness of a red experience, the itchiness of an itch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And we're trying to account for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're trying to bring them into our theory of reality and postulating some mechanism

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: does not deal with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think we've got to realize dealing with consciousness is a radically different explanatory

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: task from other tasks of science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Other tasks of science, we're trying to explain behavior in terms of simpler forms of behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In the case of consciousness, we're trying to explain these invisible subjective qualities

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: that you can't see from the outside, but that you're immediately aware of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The reason materialism perhaps continues to dominate is people think, look at the success

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of science, it's incredible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Look at all the, you know, it's explained all this, surely it's going to explain consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I think we have to appreciate there's a radically different explanatory task here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so, I mean, the neuroscientist, Anil Seth, who I've had lots of intense but friendly

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: discussions with, you know, wants to compare consciousness to life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I think there's this radical difference that in the case of life, again, we come back

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to public observation, all of the data, publicly observable data, we're basically trying to

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: explain complex behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The way you do that is identify mechanisms, simpler mechanisms that explicate that behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's the task in physics, chemistry, neurobiology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But in the case of consciousness, that's not what we're trying to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're trying to account for these subjective qualities and you postulate a mechanism that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: might explain behavior, but it doesn't explain the redness of a red experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But still, I mean, still ultimately the hope is that we will have some kind of hierarchical

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So we take the causal dynamics of physics, we hypothesize that that's filled out with

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: certain forms of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then at higher levels, we get more complex causal dynamics filled out by more complex

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: forms of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And ultimately we get to us, hopefully.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So yeah, so there's still a sort of hierarchical explanatory framework there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So you kind of mentioned the hierarchy of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Do you think it's possible to, within the panpsychist framework, to measure consciousness or put

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: another way, are some things more conscious than others in the panpsychist view?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's a difficult question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, I do see consciousness as a dealing with consciousness, an interdisciplinary task

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: between something more experimental, which is to do with the ongoing project of trying

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to work out what people call the neural correlates of consciousness, what kinds of physical brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: activity correspond to conscious experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's one part of it, but I think essentially there's also a theoretical question of more

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the why question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Why do those kinds of brain activity go along with certain kinds of conscious experience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't think you can answer that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Because consciousness is not publicly observable, I don't think you can answer that why question

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: with an experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But they have to go hand in hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, one of the theories I'm attracted to is the integrated information theory, according

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to which we find consciousness at the level at which there is most integrated information,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and they try to give a mathematically precise definition of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So on that view, probably this cup of tea isn't conscious because there's probably more

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: integrated information in the molecules making up the tea than there is in the liquid as

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a whole.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But in the brain, what is distinctive about the brain is that there's a huge amount of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: integrated, there's more integrated information in the system than there is in individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So that's why they claim that that's the basis of consciousness at the macro level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I like some features of this theory, but they do talk about degrees of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They do want to say there is gradations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I'm not sure conceptually I can kind of make sense of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, there are things to do with consciousness that are graded like complexity or levels

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of information, but I'm not sure whether experience itself admits a degree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I sort of think something either has experience or it doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It might have very simple experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It might have very complex experience, but experience itself, I don't think it admits

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a degree in that sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's not more experience, less experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I sort of find that conceptually hard to make sense of, but I'm kind of open-minded on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So when we have a lot higher resolution of sensory information, don't you think that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: correlated to the richness of the experience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So doesn't more information provide a richer experience or is that again, thinking quantitatively

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and not thinking about the subjective experience?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You can experience a lot with very little sensory information perhaps.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Do you think those are connected?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So there are features, characteristics here we can grade, the complexity of the experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And on the integrated information theory, they correlate that in terms of mathematically

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: identifiable structure with integrated information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So roughly, it's a quite unusual notion of information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's perhaps not the standard way one thinks about information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's to do with constraining past and future possibilities of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the idea is in the retina of the eye, there's a huge amount of possible states the retina

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of my eye could be in at the next moment, depending on what light goes into it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whereas the possible next states of the brain are much more constrained.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Obviously, it responds to the environment, but it heavily constrains its past and future

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so that's the idea of information they have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then the second idea is how much that information is dependent on integration.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: not lose that much information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's not dependent on interconnections.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: way it stores information is dependent on the interconnections of the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So yeah, so that's one proposal for how to measure one gradable characteristic which

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Can a cockroach suffer heartbreak?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But certainly there's kinds of fear of your own death, concern about whether there's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: purpose to existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: These are forms of suffering that aren't available to most non-human animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whatever there's an overall scale that we could put physical and emotional suffering

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: on and identify where you are on that scale, I'm not so sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So it's like humans have a much bigger menu of experiences, much bigger selection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In one sense at least.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: There's like a page that's suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: This menu of experiences, like you have the omelets and the breakfast and so on, and one

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of the pages is suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We have a lot compared to a hamster, a lot more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But in one individual thing that we share with a hamster, that experience, it's difficult

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to argue that we experience it deeper than others, like hunger or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Physical pain, I'm not sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I mean, there are kinds of experiences animals have that we don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Bats echolocate around the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The philosopher Thomas Nagel famously pointed out that no matter how much you understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of the neurophysiology of bats, you'll still know what it's like to squeal and find your

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: way around by listening to the echoes bounce off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So yeah, I mean, I guess I feel the intuition that there's emotional suffering is I want

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to say deeper than physical suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't know how to make that statement precise though.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So one of the ways I think about, I think people think about consciousness is in connection

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So let me just ask about suffering because that's how people think about animals, cruelty

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to animals or cruelty to living things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They connect that to suffering and to consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think there's a sense in which those are two are deeply connected when people are thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: about just public policy, they're thinking about philosophy, engineering, psychology,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: sociology, political science, all of those things have to do with human suffering and

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: animal suffering, life suffering.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And that's connected to consciousness in a lot of people's minds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Is it connected like that for you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the capacity to suffer, is it also somehow strongly correlated with the capacity to experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: consciously?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I would say suffering is a kind of experience and so you have to be conscious to suffer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: People taking more unusual views of consciousness seriously now, panpsychism is one radical

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Another one is what's become known as illusionism, the view that consciousness, at least in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: sense that philosophers think about it, doesn't really exist at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So my podcast Mind Chat, I host with a committed illusionist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So the gimmick is I think consciousness is everywhere, he thinks it's nowhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so that's one very simple way of avoiding all these problems, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If consciousness doesn't exist, we don't need to explain it, job done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Although we might still have to explain why we seem to be conscious, why it's so hard

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to get out of the idea that we're conscious.

body.input: exist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: He thinks it's an illusion.

body.input: The brain tricks us into thinking we feel pain, but we don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And how we should think about morality in the light of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Consciousness at the fundamental level is the hardware on which the software of physics

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: runs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Just because a certain bit of software could run on two different kinds of hardware, it

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: doesn't mean the hardware isn't doing anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: your desktop isn't doing anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Similarly, just because there could be another universe in which the physics is realized

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in non-conscious stuff, it doesn't mean the consciousness in our universe isn't doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So if something's doing something, it is.

body.input: In your view, it's not emergent.

body.input: And more than that, it's doing quite a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's the only thing that exists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: not really doing that much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But it feels like consciousness is doing quite a lot of work and interacting with the environment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: If you remove consciousness, it's not just that you remove the experience of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It feels like you're also going to remove a lot of the progress of human civilization,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: society, and all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It just feels like consciousness has a lot of value in how we develop our society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and all of those kinds of things, it seems like consciousness in all different flavors

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: that there's not even an experience of free will.

body.input: It's pretty interesting, that claim, and it feels like you can build up intuitions about

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261
