body.input: Yeah, that's interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, I hadn't thought about the comparison.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, so there are different arguments here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: One argument I've heard Sam Harris give that's pretty common in philosophy is this sort of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: thought that we can't make sense of a middle way between a choice being determined by prior

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: causes and it just being totally random and senseless, like the random decay of radioactive

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: isotope or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think there was a good answer to that by the philosopher Jonathan Lowe, who's not necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: very well known outside academic philosophy, but he's a hugely influential figure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think one of the best philosophers of recent times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: He sadly died of cancer a few years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Actually spent almost all of his career at Durham University, which is where I am, so

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: it was one reason it was a great honor to get a job there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But anyway, his answer to that was what makes the difference between a free action and a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: totally senseless one, senseless random event, is that free choice involves responsiveness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So again, we were talking about this earlier, if I'm deciding whether to take a job in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: US or to stay in the UK, I weigh up considerations, different standard of life maybe, or being

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: close to family or cultural difference, I weigh them up and I edge towards a decision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think that is sufficient to distinguish it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're hypothetically supposing, trying to make sense of this idea, not saying it's real,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: but that could be enough to distinguish it from a senseless idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's not a senseless random occurrence, because the free decision involved responsiveness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think that just answers that particular philosophical objection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So what is the middle way between determined by prior causes and totally random?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Well, there's an action, a choice that's not determined by prior causes, but it's not just

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: random because the decision essentially involved responsiveness to reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So that's the answer to that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I think actually that kind of thought also, I think you were hinting at the famous

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: liberty experiments where he got his subjects to perform some kind of random action of pressing

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a button and then note the time they decided to press it, quote unquote, and then he's

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: scanning the brains and he claims to have found that about half a second before they

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: consciously decided to press the button, the brain is getting ready to perform that action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So he claimed that about half a second before the person has consciously decided to press

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the button, the brain has already started the activity that's going to lead to the action.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then later people have claimed that there's a difference of maybe seven to 10 seconds.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, there are all sorts of issues with these experiments.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But one is that as far as I'm aware, all of the quote unquote choices they focused on

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: are just these totally random senseless actions like just pressing a button for no reason.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I think the kind of free will we're interested in is free choice that involves responsiveness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to reasons, weighing up considerations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And those kind of free decisions might not happen like at an identifiable instant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: When you're weighing it up, should I get married?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You might edge slowly towards one side or the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so it could be that maybe the liberty, I think there are other problems with the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: liberty stuff, but maybe they show that we can't freely choose to do something totally

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: senseless, whatever that would mean.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But that doesn't show we can't freely in this strong libertarian sense respond to considerations

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of reason and value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: To be fair, it will be difficult to see what kind of experiment we could set up to test

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But just because we can't yet set up that kind of experiment, we shouldn't pretend we know

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: more than we do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So yeah, so for those reasons, and well, the third consideration you raised is different.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: This is the debate I have with Sean Carroll.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Would this conflict with physics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I just think we don't know enough about the brain to know whether there are causal dynamics

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in the brain that are not reducible to underlying chemistry and physics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So then Sean Carroll says, well, that would mean our physics is wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So he focuses on the core theory, which is the name for standard model of particle physics

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: plus the weak limit of general relativity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So we can't totally bring quantum mechanics and relativity together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But actually the circumstances in which we can't bring them together are just in situations

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of very high gravity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: For example, when you're about to go into a black hole or something, actually in terrestrial

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: circumstances we can bring them together in the core theory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then Sean wants to say, well, we can be very confident that core theory is correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And so if there were libertarian free will in the brain, the core theory would be wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And actually, I mean, this is something I'm not sure about and I'm still thinking about

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and I'm learning from my discussion with Sean, but I'm still not totally clear why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It could be, suppose we did discover strong emergence in the brain, whether it's free

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: will or something else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Perhaps what we would say is not that the core theory is wrong, but we'd say the core

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: theory is correct in its own terms, namely capturing the causal capacities of particles

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and fields.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But then it's a further assumption whether they're the only things that are running the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: show.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Maybe there are also fundamental causal capacities associated with systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then if we discover this strong emergence, then when we work out what happens in the

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: brain, we have to look to the core theory, the causal capacities of particles and fields,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and we have to look to what we know about these strongly emergent causal capacities

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of systems and maybe they co-determine what happens in the system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I don't know whether that makes sense or not, but I mean, the more important point,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, that's in a way a kind of branding point, how we brand this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The more important point is we just don't know enough about the workings of the brain

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to know whether there are strongly emergent causal dynamics, whether or not that would

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: mean we have to modify physics or maybe just we think physics is not the total story of

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: what's running the show.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But we just, if it turned out empirically that everything's reducible to underlying

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: physics and chemistry, sure, I would drop any commitment to libertarian free will in

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a heartbeat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's an empirical question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Maybe that's why, as you say, in principle, it's easier to get a grip on, but we're a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: million miles away from being at that stage.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Well, I don't know if we're a million miles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I hope we're not because one of the ways I think to get to it is by engineering systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So my hope is to understand intelligence by building intelligent systems, to understand

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: consciousness by building systems that, let's say the easy thing, which is not the easy

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: thing, but the first thing, which is to try to create the illusion of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Through that process, I think you start to understand much more about consciousness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: about intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then the same with free will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think those are all tied very closely together, at least from our narrow human perspective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And we try to engineer systems that interact deeply with humans, that form friends with

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: humans that humans fall in love with and they fall in love with humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Then you start to have to try to deeply understand ourselves, to try to deeply understand what

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: is intelligence in the human mind, what is consciousness, what is free will.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I think engineering is just another way to do philosophy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: No, I certainly think there's a role for that and it would be an important consideration

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: if we could seemingly replicate in an artificial way the ability to choose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That would be a consideration in thinking about these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But there's still the question of whether that's how we do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So even if we could replicate behavior in a certain way in an artificial system, until

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: we understand the workings of our brains, it's not clear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That's how we do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And as I say, the kind of free will I'm interested in is where we respond to reasons, considerations

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: How would we tell whether a system was genuinely grasping and responding to facts about value

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: or whether they were just replicating, giving the impression of doing so?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I don't know even how to think about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: On the process to building them, I think we'll get a lot of insights.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And once they become conscious, what's going to happen is exactly the same thing is happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in chess now, which is once the chess engines far superseded the capabilities of humans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: humans just kind of forgot about them or they use them to help them out to study and stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But we still say, okay, let the engines be and then we humans will just play amongst

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: each other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Just like dolphins and hamsters are not so concerned about humans except for a source

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of food, they do their own thing and let us humans launch rockets into space and all that

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They don't care.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think we'll just focus on ourselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But in the process of building intelligent systems, conscious systems, I think we'll

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: get to get a deeper understanding of the role of consciousness in the human mind and what

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: are its origins?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Is it the base layer of reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Is it strongly merger phenomena of the brain or just as you sort of brilliantly put here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: it could be both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They're not mutually exclusive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Dealing with consciousness needs to be an interdisciplinary task.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We need philosophers, neuroscientists, physicists, engineers replicating these things artificially

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and all needs to be working in step.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I'm quite interested.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: More and more scientists get in touch with me actually saying that was one of the great

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: things about I think that's come from writing a popular book is not just getting the ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: out to a general audience, but getting the ideas out to scientists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I had scientists get in touch saying, this in some way connects to my work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I would like to start to put together an interdisciplinary network of scientists and philosophers and

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: engineers perhaps interested in a panpsychist approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think so far panpsychism has just been sort of trying to justify its existence and that's

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: important, but I think once you just get on with an active research program, that's when

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: people start taking it seriously, I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Do you think we're living in a simulation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: No.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think- Is there some aspect of that thought experiment that's compelling to you within

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the framework of panpsychism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's an important and serious argument and it's not to be laughed away.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I suppose one issue I have with it is there's a crucial assumption there that consciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: is substrate independent as the jargon goes, which means it's what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: No, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Beautifully put, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's software rather than hardware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's depend on organization rather than the stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Whereas as a panpsychist, I think consciousness is the stuff of the brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's the stuff of matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think just taking the organizational properties, the software in my brain and uploading

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: them, you wouldn't get the stuff of my brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I am actually worried if at some point in the future we start uploading our minds and

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: we think, oh my God, granny is still there, I can email granny after her body is rotted

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: in the ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And when we all start uploading our brains, it could be we're just committing suicide.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: We're just getting rid of our consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Because I think that wouldn't for me preserve the experience, just getting the software

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: features.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So anyway, that's a crucial premise of this simulation argument because the idea in a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: simulated universe, I don't think you necessarily would have consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's interesting that you as a panpsychist are attached because to me, panpsychism would

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: encourage the thought that there's not a significant difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: At the very bottom, it's not substrate independent, but you can have consciousness in a human

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and then move it to something else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You can move it to the cloud, you can move it to the computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It feels like that's much more possible if consciousness is the base layer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yes, you could certainly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It allows for the possibility of creating artificial consciousness, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Because there's not souls, there aren't any kind of extra magical ingredients.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So yeah, it definitely allows the possibility of artificial consciousness and maybe preserving

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: my consciousness in some sort of artificial way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: My only point I suppose is just replicating the computational or organisational features

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: would not for me preserve consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Some opponents of materialism disagree with me on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think David Chalmers is an opponent of materialist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: He's a kind of dualist, but he thinks the way these psychophysical laws work, they hook

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: onto the computational or organisational features of matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think he thinks you could upload your consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I tend to think not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In that sense, we're not living in simulation in the sort of specific computational view

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of things and that substrate matters to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Yeah, I think so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In that you agree with Sean Carroll that physics matters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Physics is our best way of capturing what the stuff of the world does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But not the what-ness, the being of the stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The is-ness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The is-ness, thank you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Russell Brand, I had a conversation with Russell Brand and he said, oh, you mean the is-ness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I thought that was a good way of putting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The is-ness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That sounds great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: The big ridiculous question, what do you think is the meaning of all of this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You write in your book that the entry for our reality in the Hitchhiker's Guide might

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: read, a physical universe whose intrinsic nature is constituted of consciousness worth

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: a visit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So our whole conversation has been about the first part of that sentence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: What about the second part?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Worth a visit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Why is this place worth a visit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Why does it have meaning?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Why does it have value at all?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: These are big questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, firstly, I do think panpsychism is important to think about for considerations

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of meaning and value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: As we've already discussed, I think consciousness is the root of everything that matters in

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: life, from deep emotions, subtle thoughts, beautiful sensory experiences.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And yet, I believe our official scientific worldview is incompatible with the reality

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I mean, that's controversial, but that's what I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think people feel this on an intuitive level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: It's maybe part of what Max Weber called the disenchantment of nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They know their feelings and experiences are not just electrochemical signaling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: They might just have that very informed intuition, but I think that can be rigorously supportive

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think this can lead to a sense of alienation and a sense that we lack a framework for understanding

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the meaning and significance of our lives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: In the absence of that, people turn to other things to make sense of the meaning of their

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: lives, like nationalism, fundamentalist religion, consumerism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So I think panpsychism is important in that regard in bringing together the quantitative

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: facts of physical science with the, as it were, the human truth, by which I just mean

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: the qualitative reality of our own experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: As I've already said, I do think there are objective facts about value and what we ought

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: to do and what we ought to believe that we respond to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And that's very mysterious to make sense of, both how there could be such facts and how

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: we could know about them and respond to them, but I do think there are such facts and they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: mostly to do with kinds of conscious experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So they're there to be discovered and much of the human condition is to discover those

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: objective sources of value.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think so, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And then, I mean, moving away from panpsychism to the, you know, at an even bigger level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I suppose I think it is important to me to live in hope that there's a purpose to existence

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: and that, you know, what I do contributes in some small way to that greater purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But you know, I would say I don't know if there's a purpose to existence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I think some things point in that direction, some things point away from it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But I don't think you need certainty or even high probability to have faith in something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So take an analogy, suppose you've got a friend who's very seriously ill, maybe there's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: 30% chance they're going to make it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: You shouldn't believe your friend's going to get better, you know, because they're probably

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: But what you can say is, you know, you can say to your friend, I have faith that you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: going to get better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: That is, I choose to live in hope about that possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I choose to orientate my life towards that hope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Similarly, you know, I don't think we know whether or not there's a purpose to existence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: but I think we can make the choice to live in hope of that possibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I find that a worthwhile and fulfilling way to live.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So maybe as your editor, I would collaborate with you on the edit of the Hitchhiker's Guide

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: Philip, you're an incredible mind, an incredible human being, and indeed are humble.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: And I'm really happy that you're able to argue and take on some of these difficult questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: with some of the most brilliant people in the world, which are the philosophers thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: about the human mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: So this was an awesome conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I hope you continue talking to folks like Sam Harris.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I'm so glad you talked to Joe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Philip Goff: Consciousness, Panpsychism, and the Philosophy of Mind | Lex Fridman Podcast #261

body.input: I can't wait to see what you write, what you say, what you think next.

body.input: Thank you so much for talking today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: well if you don't know how to play.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And then in this board, you have, again, pieces like in chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: But these pieces are not there initially

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: to decide which pieces to build.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So in a way, you're starting almost with no pieces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And then once you have enough pieces or maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So as a result, you must not only

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: all in real time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: There's also, unlike chess, this is not a turn-based game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: You play basically all the time continuously

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And people that train for this really
