metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: But is there other strategies that you discovered

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: interesting, unique to this game?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Yeah, so if you look at the kind of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: not being a StarCraft II player,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but of course StarCraft and StarCraft II

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and real time strategy games in general are very similar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: I would classify perhaps the openings of the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: They're very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And generally I would say there's two kinds of openings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: One that's a standard opening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: That's generally how players find sort of a balance

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: between risk and economy and building some units early on

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: so that they could defend,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but they're not too exposed basically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but also expanding quite quickly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So this would be kind of a standard opening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And within a standard opening,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: then what you do choose generally is

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: what technology are you aiming towards?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So there's a bit of rock, paper, scissors of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: you could go for spaceships

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or you could go for invisible units

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or you could go for, I don't know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: like massive units that attack against

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: certain kinds of units,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but they're weak against others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So standard openings themselves have some choices

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: like rock, paper, scissors style.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Of course, if you scout and you're good at guessing

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: what the opponent is doing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: then you can play as an advantage

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: because if you know you're gonna play rock,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: I mean, I'm gonna play paper obviously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So you can imagine that normal standard games in StarGraph

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: looks like a continuous rock, paper, scissors game

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: where you guess what the distribution of rock, paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and scissors is from the enemy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and reacting accordingly to try to beat it

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or put the paper out before he kind of changes his mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: from rock to scissors

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and then you would be in a weak position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So sorry to pause on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: I didn't realize this element

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: because I know it's true with poker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: I looked at Lebronis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: You're also estimating, trying to guess the distribution,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: trying to better and better estimate the distribution

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: of what the opponent is likely to be doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Yeah, I mean, as a player,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: you definitely wanna have a belief state

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: over what's up on the other side of the map.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And when your belief state becomes inaccurate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: when you start having serious doubts

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: whether he's gonna play something that you must know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that's when you scout.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: You wanna then gather information, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Is improving the accuracy of the belief

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or improving the belief state part of the loss

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that you're trying to optimize

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or is it just a side effect?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: It's implicit, but you could explicitly model it

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and it would be quite good at probably predicting

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: what's on the other side of the map.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: But so far it's all implicit.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: There's no additional reward for predicting the enemy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So there's these standard openings

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and then there's what people call cheese,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: which is very interesting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And AlphaStar sometimes really likes this kind of cheese.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: These cheeses, what they are is kind of an all-in strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: You're gonna do something sneaky.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: You're gonna hide your own buildings

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: close to the enemy base,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or you're gonna go for hiding your technological buildings

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: so that you do invisible units

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and the enemy just cannot react to detect it

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and thus lose the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And there's quite a few of these cheeses

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and variants of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And there is where actually the belief state

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: becomes even more important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Because if I scout your base and I see no buildings at all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: any human player knows something's up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: They might know, well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: you're hiding something close to my base.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Should I build suddenly a lot of units to defend?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Should I actually block my ramp with workers

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: so that you cannot come and destroy my base?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So all this is happening

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and defending against cheeses is extremely important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And in the Alpha Star League, many agents

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: actually develop some cheesy strategies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And in the games we saw against TLO and Mana,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: two out of the 10 agents were actually doing

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: these kinds of strategies, which are cheesy strategies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And then there's a variant of cheesy strategy

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: which is called all-in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So an all-in strategy is not perhaps as drastic as,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: oh, I'm gonna build cannons on your base

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and then bring all my workers

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and try to just disrupt your base and game over,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: or GG, as we say in StarCraft.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: There's these kind of very cool things

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that you can align precisely at a certain time mark.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So for instance, you can generate exactly 10 unit composition

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that is perfect, like five of this type,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: five of this other type, and align the upgrade

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: so that at four minutes and a half, let's say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: you have these 10 units and the upgrade just finished.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And at that point, that army is really scary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And unless the enemy really knows what's going on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: if you push, you might then have an advantage

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: because maybe the enemy is doing something more standard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: it expanded too much, it developed too much economy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and it trade off badly against having defenses,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and the enemy will lose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: But it's called all-in because if you don't win,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: then you're gonna lose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So you see players that do these kinds of strategies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: if they don't succeed, game is not over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: I mean, they still have a base

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and they still gathering minerals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but they will just GG out of the game

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: because they know, well, game is over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: I gambled and I failed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So if we start entering the game theoretic aspects

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: of the game, it's really rich, and it's really,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that's why it also makes it quite entertaining to watch,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: even if I don't play, I still enjoy watching the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: But the agents are trying to do this mostly implicitly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but one element that we improved in self-play

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: is creating the Alpha Star League.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And the Alpha Star League is not pure self-play,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: it's trying to create a different personalities of agents

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: so that some of them will become cheesy agents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: Some of them might become very economical, very greedy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: like getting all the resources,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but then being maybe early on, they're gonna be weak,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: but later on, they're gonna be very strong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And by creating this personality of agents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: which sometimes it just happens naturally

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that you can see kind of an evolution of agents

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that given the previous generation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: they train against all of them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: and then they generate kind of the perfect counter

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: to that distribution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: But these agents, you must have them in the populations

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: because if you don't have them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: you're not covered against these things, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: It's kind of, you wanna create all sorts of the opponents

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that you will find in the wild,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: so you can be exposed to these cheeses,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: early aggression, later aggression, more expansions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: dropping units in your base from the side, all these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: And pure self-play is getting a bit stuck

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: at finding some subset of these, but not all of these.

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: So the AlphaStar League is a way to kind of

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: do an ensemble of agents

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: that they're all playing in a league,

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: much like people play on Battle.net, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: They play, you play against someone

metadata.title: Podcast: Oriol Vinyals: DeepMind AlphaStar, StarCraft, and Language | Lex Fridman Podcast #20

body.input: right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It's better to rule in hell than serve in heaven.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So I would have to go with the pigs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So I guess I'd be a cop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Snow wallet of the others.

body.input: I would say it's not, it's sure it's an allegory about the Russian Revolution, but I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Orwell's point was this is broader towards most totalitarian dictatorships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I mean, it could very easily be read as an indictment of Mussolini or Hitler or many

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: of these others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I'm a huge George Orwell fan.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: One of the things that I think people on the right need to appreciate is the courage of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: many of these undisputably left-wing voices who were the strongest ones to take on totalitarian

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And the three I can think of off the top of my head who are all in my top 10 heroes of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: all time are Emma Goldman, Albert Camus, and Orwell being the third.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Something that leftists like to throw in the face of people on the right who constantly

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: invoke Orwell is that Orwell said, and I don't have the exact quote off the top of my head,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: but something to the effect of every word I have written should be taken as a defense

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: of democratic socialism against totalitarianism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So people like Truman was obviously very hardcore in many ways, anti-communist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: We like to parse things out, you're going to laugh, into binary fashions that left good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: right bad, or right good, left bad.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But historically speaking, it does not fall away into these camps as easily as people

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: would like.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And I think it is important for those of us, it takes a lot more courage to fight the right

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: from the right or to fight the left from the left because in a sense, a lot of your countrymen

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: or your fellow travelers are going to regard you as a traitor to the cause.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So every chance I get, I will sing the praises of these three figures among others who not

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: only, even if they hadn't done what they had done, just lived just amazing lives that all

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: of us can learn from and admire and regard as somewhat a role model.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: What was the nature of their opposition to totalitarianism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Is it basically freedom?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Is it the value of freedom?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Let's go to the three of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So Emma Goldman, she was an early anarchist figure, we'll talk about her later, I'm sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: She got deported from the United States with her partner in crime, Alexander Berkman, literal

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: crime, he tried to assassinate Frick, who was Andrew Carnegie's main man in the Pittsburgh

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: steel mill strike.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: She got deported to the Soviet Union and they're like, oh, you want socialism?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Because at the time the anarchists were regarded as socialist, go choke on it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And she's there and she was watching in great horror what was going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And she actually went to Lenin's office and she goes, this isn't what we're about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: The revolution is about the individual and free speech and everyone working together

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: to further society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And he told her that, you know, free speech is a bourgeois contrivance and regardless,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: you can't have these circumstances in the midst of a revolution.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And when she left the Soviet Union, she went to Britain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And at the time, before the 1917, there was a lot of discussion among socialist circles

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: about what would the revolution look like, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Would there be the Bakunin anarchist model?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Would there be the Marxist model?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Obviously, the Bolsheviks ended up winning, but even then it wasn't obvious because there

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: was the Bolsheviks and the Mensheviks and what people, you know, you and I know what

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: those words mean, but Bolsheviks were kind of funny because Bolsheviks means bigger and

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Mensheviks means smaller.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: The Mensheviks had the numbers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It was sarcastic that they were called Mensheviks and the Bolsheviks were called Bolsheviks

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and Lenin, you know, destroyed all his foes in a very merciless way, obviously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Beforehand, you know, there was the idea like, well, all these cockamamie ideas, we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: to work together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You know, we don't know what it's going to look like for the cause.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Then as soon as he sees power, he's like, yeah, yeah, we're not doing that kind of pluralism

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: This is going to be the right approach.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So she left the Soviet Union, as did Berkman.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: She wrote a book that they titled My Disillusionment with Russia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And I remember this one anecdote, which I'm going to discuss in a forthcoming book, where

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: she goes to Britain and the British were very red at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: They really had something called the Fabian Society, which was the predecessor to the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: British Labour Party, which were like, all right, we're going to get rid of liberalism

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and have a socialist kind of nation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And she gave talks and there was this one time where she gave a talk and she started

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and there was a standing ovation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: By the time she was done, you could hear a pin drop because she dared to look at these

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: people in the face, something they'd been fighting for all their lives and saying, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: know, we've been to the future and it works.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And she's like, guys, this is worse than the czar.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You know, people are under house arrest.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You're not allowed to have, you know, newspapers are being shut down if they have heretical

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: views, so on and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And you know, she was just even more of a pariah than she had been previously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So she is, you know, deserves huge accolades in that regard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I brought her up and we were talking about with our conversation with Yaron Orwell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I think you don't need me to explain what he has done and continues to do to use fiction

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: to demonstrate the horrors of a totalitarian state.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And Camus, who might be my all time, you know, great lighthouse, so to speak, in terms of

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: being a man of conscience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You know, he joined the Communist Party and for a lot of people in the States, you hear,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: oh, you joined the Communist Party, so I need to hear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So all you need to, he was a communist, all you need to know, he joined the Communist

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Party because they were the main ones fighting the fascists in France and other locations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And he took Nazism, as did many others, of course, very, very, very seriously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He wasn't some committed communist, but this was just his mechanism to take on, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: be part of the underground in Vichy France and so on and so forth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So he had the quote, which is ascribed to him, which is kind of a misquote.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Howard Zinn is the one who actually said it, that it is a job of thinking people not to

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: be on the side of the executioners.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And he very much felt, if you read his speech when he won the Nobel Prize, I forget, it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: in the 50s, where he goes, it's basically the job of writers to keep civilization from

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: destroying himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I don't think I'm ever going to be a man on the level of Camus and what he's accomplished,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: but I think that vision of it is the job of writers to be the conscience and to point

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: out, you know, this is the leftism at its best when, you know, giving voice to the voiceless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: When you have the machine of the state crushing and marginalizing people and they might not

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: be educated, literate, or have any power at all, he's the guy who's like, you are ruining

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: humans, these humans matter, and I'm not going to let you look the other way and act like

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: you don't know what you're doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So in this time, whether we look at the time of fascism or we look at the fictional animal

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: farm, what's the heroic action then?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So Camus joined the Communist Party, there's a bunch of different heroic actions, some

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: more heroic than others, not just for the, you know, hero is the wrong word in terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: of like effectiveness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: What's the effective action, I guess is what I want to ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: As a writer, as a thinker, as somebody with a mind, what's the heroic action?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: That's a tricky question because a lot of times in the West, heroism is regardless intertwined

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: with martyrdom, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So it's kind of this idea of like you have to speak to, you know, Camus always talked

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: about let justice be done though the heavens fall.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: right thing, even the consequences might not be what you like, and I think that is a good

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: loose definition of heroism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So if you, I'll give you one example of heroism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: This was the line to Auschwitz, I believe it was, and you know, there's the Nazi guards

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: keeping everyone along and if you were a certain, I think if you were under 12, they killed

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: you or some, there was some age limit where some kids were killed or some were not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and it ended up saving the kid's life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So I think heroism in this context is defiance and standing true to values of liberalism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: humanism and venerating the sanctity of human life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I think that, and I think it's also important to pick your battles.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I don't think if, you know, he got, that Nazi over there got in a bullhorn and said, hey,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: this is the rules, blah, blah, blah, blah, blah, that's not going to help anyone do

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: anything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I think, you know, people a lot of times attack me from my anarchist views.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It's like, oh, you know, would you call the police?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Would you use the roads?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Would you pay your income taxes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You know, I got an argument with Tim Pool because there was that couple, I think in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: what was that, Missouri or Illinois when they had their guns and they were being arrested

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and they basically took a plea deal and he said, you should have fought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I go, it's a lot easier to say you should fight, but we don't know what circumstance

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: someone is under.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And what these totalitarian regimes did very, very well as you know is if you were a target

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and they can't get through to you, that's fine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You have a family.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So you can sit there, Lex, and gird your jaw and you can stand up to all the torture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: What are we going to do about your wife?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: What about your mom?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: for certain crimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: you're not committed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You're going to admit to any crime you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He said explicitly about things like gulags, like even if it's true, we shouldn't talk

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: People would have all sorts of contradictions and it's not at all clear and they'll have

body.input: the death penalty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And again, he's saying, I'm not saying killing a murderer is wrong.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: over her.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I think we've seen countless examples of human beings, especially when human beings have

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: cruelty.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: That is something as Soviets, you and I are very painfully aware of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It's not just about the oppression, which is bad enough as it is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: was the dictator of Romania.

body.input: in the Second World, the Soviet Bloc, some are more liberal than others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: When somebody's an asshole to you, you walk away or when somebody's an asshole to you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: you turn the other cheek and give them a chance to rise to the best version of themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and then find a common ground kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It's an open question of how to form those collectives when there's people with difficult

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: childhoods and all that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It also comes down to what is your relationship with this person?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Is this out of character?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: If you and I got into a disagreement, all of a sudden you started getting very personal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: First I'd be very hurt, but then I'd be like, this is out of character for Lex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I'm sure I could be like, let's take a pause here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: You're getting heated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I'm trying to work this out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: What's going on here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And you get a kind of a meta conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But again, you and I have a relationship of mutual respect.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So as opposed to if it was a stranger who just wants a piece of you, it's just like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: you are coming at me not correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I don't have to reciprocate in kind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I'm not going to shoot you, but I'm not going to pretend that you deserve respect when you're

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: treating me with such contempt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I do defer, especially with people I know, because this is smart long-term game theory

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: as well as the right thing to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I do try to give them the benefit of the doubt at first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Because if you're going to go aggro, you can't go back, but you could always go from like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: let me hear them out and then I could go aggro.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So there is a big asymmetry there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And that's, I mean, I don't think anyone has the answer to this question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Is that the right strategy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: To me, game theoretically seems the right strategy is to-

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: With reciprocity is what game theory says is the right strategy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: They did the prisoner's dilemma and they found tit for tat is the one that's the most advantageous.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So that's for when it's perfectly rational actors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But when you have, I mean, there's noise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: There's I think benefit to just, even if they keep being shitty to you, still being nice

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: to them for a while.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Well, then there's the inverse where girls are turned off.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Some people are like, if you're in a relationship and not just girls, but girls, like some people,

body.input: I mean, this is nothing that necessarily do with anarchism so much as like, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: human beings are infinitely complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: We don't know if we know the backstory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: For example, just yesterday, Jay, who's here is one of my closest friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I had a dinner with a bunch of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I couldn't bring a plus four, so he wasn't invited.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He didn't know the circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He just thought we were having dinner without him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He was hurt.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Once I spelled it out, he completely understood.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I felt horrible because for me, to have any of my friends feel left out is just a very,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: very cruel thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I felt bad and I'm glad to apologize again publicly that that's ended up being the circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But yeah, a lot of times we're also in Plato's cave.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: When you're dealing with somebody else, you have very, very limited information about

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: their background and circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: That's why I will always, if it's someone I even have a little bit of relationship with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: try to give them the benefit of the doubt because I found, especially this comes from

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: being a co-author, when you co-author books and you're walking other people's shoes, you

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: don't know a lot of the information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: A lot of times it's just a misunderstanding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But isn't that a fundamentally anarchist question of how we figure out this puzzle of human

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: complexities in order to form voluntary collectives?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: We have to figure that out, how to make people feel good, how to make people-

body.input: I agree.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: That's fair.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I think not only anarchists have to think about this as my point, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: We have to think about it more than others do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: The state.

body.input: Okay, rigid hierarchies.

body.input: Forced hierarchies is the- Forced hierarchies.

body.input: Forced hierarchies.

body.input: Okay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So do you think it's possible that humans, when left on their own accord, they form hierarchies

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: naturally?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Yes, inevitably in my opinion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Inevitably.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Which is why I disagree with the left anarchist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I think it's not a coherent thing to argue for non-hierarchical relationships.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Even in theory, it doesn't make sense to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And I know the old school anarchist will call me stupid or uninformed, but I've never been

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: able to even wrap my head around this claim that you could have relationships with that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: hierarchy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Right, so I guess there's a certain sense in which we're living in anarchism now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: to each other, but isn't the United States just a collective that was formed in anarchy?

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And this is just the collective that we're operating under, this hierarchy that was naturally

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: formed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Well, the United States was not naturally formed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It was formed by force and by fiat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But to your point, I stress this throughout the book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: I always say this anarchism is not a location, it's a relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So yeah, you and I do have a hierarchy in that this is your show, but neither of us

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: really has an authority over the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Like I'm here voluntarily, you can kick me out if you want, I can leave it if you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Neither of us has the power to force the other to be in this relationship we've chosen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: My lawyer, I defer to his judgment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He's not forcing me to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: He gives me his advice and I can take it or leave it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: Same with the doctor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So there is a clearly like who's in charge and who's not in charge, but they're not in

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: a position to impose their will on anybody else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And you could very easily see John is Stephanie's lawyer and Stephanie is John's doctor.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And in each of those contexts, one has this position of ostensible authority over the

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So anarchism is in fact not some utopian crazy thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: It is the norm of human relationships where you meet people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: and you are legally or morally obligated to follow my wishes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: But what the anarchist argument is, they're not in a position to force you to make that

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: choice.

body.input: that dilemma.

body.input: So even-

body.input: I see.

body.input: There's ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: And the anarchist answer is never.

body.input: And the difference- just one more thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: The anarchist view is the difference between that mugger and the government is only an

metadata.title: Podcast: Michael Malice: Totalitarianism and Anarchy | Lex Fridman Podcast #200

body.input: So is it possible that every hierarchy that gets big enough and successful enough such

body.input: in your sense, the way the United States government is amoral?

body.input: the United States government is uniquely or especially immoral.

body.input: Right, government's-

body.input: So won't every-
