body.input: Somehow I had channeled Guido, designed a pseudocode that was the same as Python, although I hadn't heard of Python at that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And from then on, that's what I've been using because it's been a good match.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So what's the story in Python behind Pytudes? Your GitHub repository with puzzles and exercises and Python is pretty fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, just it seemed like fun.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: You know, you know, I like doing puzzles and I like being an educator.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I did a class with Udacity, Udacity 212.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think it was it was basically problem solving using Python and looking at different problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Does Pytudes feed that class in terms of the exercises?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I was wondering what the class the class came first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Some of the stuff that's in Pytudes was write ups of what was in the class.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And then some of it was just continuing to to work on new problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So what's the organizing madness of Pytudes?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Is it just a collection of cool exercises?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Just whatever I thought was fun. OK, awesome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So you were the director of search quality at Google from 2001 to 2005 in the early days when there's just a few employees and when the when the company was growing like crazy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Right. So I mean, Google revolutionized the way we discover, share and aggregate knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So just this is a this is one of the fundamental aspects of civilization, right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Is information being shared and there's different mechanisms throughout history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: But Google is just 10x improved that right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And you're a part of that right. People discovering that information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So what were some of the challenges on a philosophical or the technical level in those early days?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: It definitely was an exciting time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And as you say, we were doubling in size every year.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And the challenges were we wanted to get the right answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And we had to figure out what that meant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: We had to implement that and we had to make it all efficient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And we had to keep on testing and seeing if we were delivering good answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And now when you say good answers, it means whatever people are typing in in terms of keywords, in terms of that kind of thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: that the that the results they get are ordered by the desirability for them of those results.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Like they're like the first thing they click on will likely be the thing that they were actually looking for.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Right. One of the metrics we had was focused on the first thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Some of it was focused on the whole page. Some of it was focused on the top three or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So we looked at a lot of different metrics for for how well we were doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And we broke it down into subclasses of, you know, maybe here's a type of of query that we're not doing well on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Then we try to fix that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Early on, we started to realize that we were in an adversarial position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Right. So we started thinking, well, we're kind of like the card catalog in the library. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So the books are here and we're off to the side and we're just reflecting what's there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And then we realized every time we make a change, the webmasters make a change and it's game theoretic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And so we had to think not only is this the right move for us to make now, but also if we make this move, what's the counter move going to be?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Is that going to get us into a work worse place? In which case we won't make that move. We'll make a different move.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And did you find, I mean, I assume with the popularity and the growth of the Internet that people were creating new content.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So you're almost helping guide the creation. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So that's certainly true. Right. So we we definitely changed the structure of the network. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So if you think back, you know, in the very early days, Larry and Sergey had the PageRank paper and John Kleinberg had this Hubs and Authorities model,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: which says the web is made out of these hubs, which will be my page of cool links about dogs or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And people would just list links and then there'd be authorities, which were the ones that page about dogs that most people link to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: That doesn't happen anymore. People don't bother to say my page of cool links because we took over that function.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Right. So so we changed the way that worked. Did you imagine back then that the Internet would be as massively vibrant as it is today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I mean, it was already growing quickly, but it's just another I don't know if you've ever seen it today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: If you sit back and just look at the Internet with wonder, the amount of content that's just constantly being created, constantly being shared.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah. Yeah. It's it's always been surprising to me. I guess I'm not very good at predicting the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I remember, you know, being a graduate student in 1980 or so.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And, you know, we had the ARPANET and then there was this proposal to commercialize it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I have this Internet and this crazy Senator Gore thought that might be a good idea. And I remember thinking, oh, come on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: You can't you can't expect a commercial company to understand this technology. They'll they'll never be able to do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah. OK, we can have this dot com domain, but it won't go anywhere. So I was wrong. Al Gore was right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: At the same time, the nature of what it means to be a commercial company has changed, too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Google is at its founding is different than, you know, what companies were before, I think. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So there's all these business models that are so different than what was possible back then.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So in terms of predicting the future, what do you think it takes to build a system that approaches human level intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: You've talked about, of course, that, you know, we shouldn't be so obsessed about creating human level intelligence, just create systems that are very useful for humans.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: But what do you think it takes to to approach that level? Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So certainly, I don't think human level intelligence is one thing. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So I think there's lots of different tasks, lots of different capabilities. I also don't think that should be the goal. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, you know, I wouldn't want to create a calculator that could do multiplication at human level. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: That would be a step backwards. And so for many things, we should be aiming far beyond human level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: For other things, maybe human level is a good level to aim at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And for others, we'd say, well, let's not bother doing this because we already have humans can take on those tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, as you say, I like to focus on what's a useful tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And in some cases, being on human level is an important part of crossing that threshold to make the tool useful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So we see in things like these personal assistants now that you get either on your phone or on a speaker that sits on the table.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: You want to be able to have a conversation with those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I think as an industry, we haven't quite figured out what the right model is for what these things can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And we're aiming towards, well, you just have a conversation with them the way you can with a person. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: But we haven't delivered on that model yet. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So you can ask it, what's the weather? You can ask it, play some nice songs and, you know, five or six other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And then you run out of stuff that it can do. In terms of a deep, meaningful connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So you've mentioned the movie Her as one of your favorite AI movies.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Do you think it's possible for a human being to fall in love with an AI system, AI assistant, as you mentioned,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: so taking this big leap from what's the weather to having a deep connection?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, I think as people, that's what we love to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I was at a showing of Her where we had a panel discussion and somebody asked me,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: what other movie do you think Her is similar to?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And my answer was Life of Brian, which is not a science fiction movie.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: But both movies are about wanting to believe in something that's not necessarily real.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, by the way, for people who don't know, it's Monty Python. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah. That's been brilliantly put. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, I mean, I think that's just the way we are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: We want to trust, we want to believe, we want to fall in love.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And it doesn't necessarily take that much. Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, you know, my kids fell in love with their teddy bear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And the teddy bear was not very interactive. Right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So that's all us pushing our feelings onto our devices and our things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I think that that's what we like to do. So we'll continue to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, yeah, as human beings, we long for that connection.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And just AI has to do a little bit of work to catch us in the other end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah. And certainly, you know, if you can get to dog level,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: a lot of people have invested a lot of love in their pets.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: In their pets. Some people, as I've been told, in working with autonomous vehicles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: have invested a lot of love into their inanimate cars. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So it really doesn't take much. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So what is a good test to linger on a topic that may be silly or a little bit philosophical?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: What is a good test of intelligence in your view?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Is natural conversation like in the Turing test a good test?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Put another way, what would impress you if you saw a computer do it these days?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, I mean, I get impressed all the time. Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Really impressive. You know, Go playing, Starcraft playing, those are all pretty cool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: You know, and I think, sure, conversation is important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think, you know, we sometimes have these tests where it's easy to fool the system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: where you can have a chatbot that can have a conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: but it never gets into a situation where it has to be deep enough that it really reveals itself as being intelligent or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think, you know, Turing suggested that, but I think if he were alive, he'd say, you know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I didn't really mean that seriously. Right. Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I think, you know, this is just my opinion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: But I think Turing's point was not that this test of conversation is a good test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think his point was having a test is the right thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So rather than having the philosopher say, oh, no, AI is impossible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: You should say, well, we'll just have a test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And then the result of that will tell us the answer and doesn't necessarily have to be a conversation test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: That's right. And coming up with a new better test as the technology evolves is probably the right way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Do you worry, as a lot of the general public does about not a lot,

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: but some vocal part of the general public about the existential threat of artificial intelligence?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So looking farther into the future, as you said, most of us are not able to predict much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So when shrouded in such mystery, there's a concern of, well, you think it started thinking about worst case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Is that something that occupies your mind space much?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So I certainly think about threats. I think about dangers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I think any new technology has positives and negatives.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And if it's a powerful technology, it can be used for bad as well as for good.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So I'm certainly not worried about the robot apocalypse and the Terminator type scenarios.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I'm worried about change in employment. And are we going to be able to react fast enough to deal with that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think we're already seeing it today where a lot of people are disgruntled about the way income inequality is working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And automation could help accelerate those kinds of problems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: The powerful technologies can always be used as weapons, whether they're robots or drones or whatever.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Some of that we're seeing due to AI. A lot of it, you know, need AI.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And I don't know what's a worst threat if it's an autonomous drone or it's CRISPR technology becoming available.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Or we have lots of threats to face and some of them involve AI and some of them don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So the threats that technology presents, are you for the most part optimistic about technology also alleviating those threats

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: or creating new opportunities or protecting us from the more detrimental effects of these things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, I don't know. Again, it's hard to predict the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And as a society so far, we've survived nuclear bombs and other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And of course, only societies that have survived are having this conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So maybe that's survivorship bias there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: What problem stands out to you as exciting, challenging, impactful to work on in the near future for yourself, for the community, and broadly?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, you know, we talked about these assistance and conversation. I think that's a great area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think combining common sense reasoning with the power of data is a great area.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: In which application? In conversation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Just in general, yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: As a programmer, I'm interested in programming tools, both in terms of the current systems we have today with TensorFlow and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Can we make them much easier to use for a broader class of people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And also, can we apply machine learning to the more traditional type of programming?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, you know, when you go to Google and you type in a query and you spell something wrong, it says, did you mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And the reason we're able to do that is because lots of other people made a similar error and then they corrected it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: We should be able to go into our code bases and our bug fix bases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: And when I type a line of code, it should be able to say, did you mean such and such?

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: If you type this today, you're probably going to type in this bug fix tomorrow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, that's a really exciting application of almost an assistant for the coding programming experience at every level.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So I think I could safely speak for the entire AI community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: First of all, for thanking you for the amazing work you've done, certainly for the amazing work you've done with AI Modern Approach book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: I think we're all looking forward very much for the fourth edition and then the fifth edition and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: So, Peter, thank you so much for talking today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Peter Norvig: Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach | Lex Fridman Podcast #42

body.input: Yeah, thank you. Pleasure.

body.input: If you did, would you tell me?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Maybe we're in a meta-turing test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Probably, it would be a good idea not to tell you,

body.input: so it doesn't change your behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This is a kind of.

body.input: Eisenberg uncertainty principle situation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If I told you you behave differently,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: maybe that's what's happening with us, of course.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This is a benchmark from the future where they replay

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: 2022 as a year before AIs were good enough yet,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and now we want to see, is it going to pass?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If I was such a program, would you

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: be able to tell, do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So to the Turing test question, you've

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: talked about the benchmark for solving intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What would be the impressive thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You've talked about winning a Nobel Prize

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and AI system winning a Nobel Prize,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but I still return to the Turing test as a compelling test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: The spirit of the Turing test is a compelling test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, the Turing test, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: it's been unbelievably influential,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and Turing's one of my all time heroes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think if you look back at the 1950 paper,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: his original paper, and read the original, you'll see,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I don't think he meant it to be a rigorous formal test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think it was more like a thought experiment, almost

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: a bit of philosophy he was writing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: if you look at the style of the paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And you can see he didn't specify it very rigorously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So for example, he didn't specify the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that the expert or judge would have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: how much time would they have to investigate this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So these are important parameters

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that are going to make it a true formal test.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And by some measures, people claim

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the Turing test passed several, a decade ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I remember someone claiming that with a very bog standard

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: normal logic model, because they pretended it was a kid.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So the judges thought that the machine was a child.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So that would be very different from an expert AI person

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: interrogating a machine and knowing how it was built

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and so on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think we should probably move away from that

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: as a formal test and move more towards a general test, where

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: we test the AI capabilities on a range of tasks

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and see if it reaches human level or above performance

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: on maybe thousands, perhaps even millions of tasks eventually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and cover the entire cognitive space.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think for its time, it was an amazing thought experiment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And also, 1950s, obviously, it was barely

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the dawn of the computer age.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So of course, he only thought about text.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And now we have a lot more different inputs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So yeah, maybe the better thing to test

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is the generalizability across multiple tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think it's also possible, as systems like Gado

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: show, that eventually that might map right back to language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you might be able to demonstrate your ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to generalize across tasks by then communicating your ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to generalize across tasks, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is kind of what we do through conversation anyway,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: when we jump around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Ultimately, what's in there in that conversation

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is not just you moving around knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's you moving around these entirely different modalities

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of understanding that ultimately map to your ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to operate successfully in all of these domains, which

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: you can think of as tasks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, I think certainly we as humans

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: use language as our main generalization communication

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: tool.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think we end up thinking in language

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and expressing our solutions in language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So it's going to be a very powerful mode in which

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to explain the system, to explain what it's doing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I don't think it's the only modality that matters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think there's going to be a lot of different ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to express capabilities other than just language.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, visual, robotics, body language, actions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the interactive aspect of all of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That's all part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But what's interesting with GATO is

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that it's pushing prediction to the maximum in terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of mapping arbitrary sequences to other sequences

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and just predicting what's going to happen next.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So prediction seems to be fundamental to intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And what you're predicting doesn't so much matter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It seems like you can generalize that quite well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So obviously, language models predict the next word.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: GATO predicts potentially any action or any token.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And it's just the beginning, really.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's our most general agent, one could call it, so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But that itself can be scaled up massively more

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: than we've done so far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And obviously, we're in the middle of doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But the big part of solving AGI is

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: creating benchmarks that help us get closer and closer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: creating benchmarks that test the generalizability.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And it's just still interesting that this fella, Alan Turing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: was one of the first and probably still one

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of the only people that was trying, maybe philosophically,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but was trying to formulate a benchmark that

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: could be followed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Even though it's fuzzy, it's still sufficiently rigorous

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: code.

body.input: And then, of course, once you start doing that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: you start adjusting it and then making your own games.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And that's when I fell in love with computers

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and realized that they were a very magical device.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: In a way, I wouldn't have been able to explain this

body.input: a magical extension of your mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I always had this feeling, and I've always

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That feels magical to me.

body.input: So all machines do that to some extent.

body.input: They all enhance our natural capabilities.
