metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But, you know, as you say, chess has been the,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I mean, Kasparov, I think rightly called it

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the drosophila of intelligence, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So it's sort of, I love that phrase.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think he's right because chess has been hand in hand

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with AI from the beginning of the whole field, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think every AI practitioner starting with Turing

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and Claude Shannon and all those,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the sort of forefathers of the field,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: tried their hand at writing a chess program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I've got original edition of Claude Shannon's

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: first chess program, I think it was 1949,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the original sort of paper.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And they all did that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And Turing famously wrote a chess program

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but all the computers around then

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: were obviously too slow to run it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So he had to run, he had to be the computer, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So he literally, I think spent two or three days

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: running his own program by hand with pencil and paper

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and playing a friend of his with his chess program.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So of course, Deep Blue was a huge moment beating Kasparov.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But actually when that happened,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I remember that very, very vividly, of course,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: because it was chess and computers and AI,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: all the things I loved when I was at college at the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I remember coming away from that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: being more impressed by Kasparov's mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: than I was by Deep Blue.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Because here was Kasparov with his human mind,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: not only could he play chess more or less

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to the same level as this brute of a calculation machine,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but of course, Kasparov can do everything else

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: humans can do, ride a bike, talk many languages,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: do politics, all the rest of the amazing things

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that Kasparov does.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And so with the same brain, and yet Deep Blue,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: brilliant as it was at chess,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: it'd been hand coded for chess

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and actually had distilled the knowledge

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of chess grand masters into a cool program,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but it couldn't do anything else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Like it couldn't even play a strictly simpler game

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: like tic-tac-toe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So something to me was missing from intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: from that system that we would regard as intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think it was this idea of generality

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and also learning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So, and that's obviously what we tried to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with AlphaGo.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, with AlphaGo and AlphaZero, MuZero,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then Gado, all the things that we'll get

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: into some parts of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: there's just a fascinating trajectory here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but let's just stick on chess briefly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: on the human side of chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You've proposed that from a game design perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the thing that makes chess compelling as a game

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is that there's a creative tension

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: between a bishop and the knight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Can you explain this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: First of all, it's really interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to think about what makes a game compelling,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: makes it stick across centuries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, I was sort of thinking about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And actually a lot of even amazing chess players

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: don't think about it necessarily

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: from a game's designer point of view.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So it's with my game design hat on

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that I was thinking about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Why is chess so compelling?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think a critical reason

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is the dynamicness of the different kind of chess positions

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: you can have, whether they're closed or open

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and other things, comes from the bishop and the knight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So if you think about how different

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the capabilities of the bishop and knight are

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: in terms of the way they move,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then somehow chess has evolved

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to balance those two capabilities more or less equally.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So they're both roughly worth three points each.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you think that dynamics is always there

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then the rest of the rules

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: are kind of trying to stabilize the game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Well, maybe, I mean, it's sort of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I don't know, it's chicken and egg situation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: probably both came together.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But the fact that it's got to this beautiful equilibrium

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: where you can have the bishop and knight,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: they're so different in power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but so equal in value across the set

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of the universe of all positions, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Somehow they've been balanced by humanity

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: over hundreds of years,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think gives the game the creative tension

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that you can swap the bishop and knights

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: for a bishop for a knight,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and they're more or less worth the same,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but now you aim for a different type of position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If you have the knight, you want a closed position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If you have the bishop, you want an open position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think that creates a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of the creative tension in chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So some kind of controlled creative tension.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: From an AI perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: do you think AI systems convention design games

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that are optimally compelling to humans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Well, that's an interesting question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Sometimes I get asked about AI and creativity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and the way I answered that is relevant to that question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: which is that I think they're different levels

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of creativity, one could say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think if we define creativity

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: as coming up with something original, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That's useful for a purpose,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: then I think the kind of lowest level of creativity

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is like an interpolation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So an averaging of all the examples you see.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So maybe very basic AI system could say

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: you could have that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you show it millions of pictures of cats,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then you say, give me an average looking cat,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: right, generate me an average looking cat.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I would call that interpolation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Then there's extrapolation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: which something like AlphaGo showed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So AlphaGo played millions of games of Go against itself,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then it came up with brilliant new ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: like move 37 in game two,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: bringing a motif strategies in Go

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that no humans had ever thought of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: even though we've played it for thousands of years

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and professionally for hundreds of years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So that I call that extrapolation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But then there's still a level above that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: which is you could call out of the box thinking

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: or true innovation, which is could you invent Go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Could you invent chess?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And not just come up with a brilliant chess move

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: or brilliant Go move,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but can you actually invent chess

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: or something as good as chess or Go?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think one day AI could,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but what's missing is how would you even specify that task

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to a program right now?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And the way I would do it if I was best telling a human

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to do it or a games designer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: a human games designer to do it is I would say something

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: like Go, I would say come up with a game

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that only takes five minutes to learn,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: which Go does, cause it's got simple rules,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: but many lifetimes to master, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Or impossible to master in one lifetime

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: cause it's so deep and so complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And then it's aesthetically beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And also it can be completed in three or four hours

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of gameplay time, which is useful for our,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: us in a human day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And so you might specify these side

body.input: of high level concepts like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of the structure of proteins, but biology is dynamic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So really, what I imagine from here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and we're working on all these things now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is protein-protein interaction, protein-lickin binding,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: so reacting with molecules.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Then you wanna build up to pathways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then eventually a virtual cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That's my dream, maybe in the next 10 years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I've been talking actually to a lot of biologists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: friends of mine, Paul Nurse, who runs the Crick Institute,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: amazing biologist, Nobel Prize-winning biologist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We've been discussing for 20 years now virtual cells.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Could you build a virtual simulation of a cell?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And if you could, that would be incredible

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: for biology and disease discovery,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: because you could do loads of experiments on the virtual cell

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and then only at the last stage validate it in the wet lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you could, in terms of the search space

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of discovering new drugs, it takes 10 years roughly

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to go from identifying a target to having a drug candidate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Maybe that could be shortened to by an order of magnitude

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with if you could do most of that work in silico.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So in order to get to a virtual cell,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: we have to build up understanding of different parts

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of biology and the interactions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And so every few years we talk about this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I talked about this with Paul, and then finally,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: last year after AlphaFold, I said, now's the time

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: we can finally go for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And AlphaFold was the first proof point

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that this might be possible.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And he's very exciting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We have some collaborations with his lab.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: They're just across the road actually from us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's a wonderful being here in King's Cross

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with the Crick Institute across the road.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think the next steps,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think there's gonna be some amazing advances

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: in biology built on top of things like AlphaFold.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We're already seeing that with the community doing that

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: after we've open sourced it and released it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I often say that I think if you think of mathematics

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is the perfect description language for physics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think AI might be end up being

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the perfect description language for biology

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: because biology is so messy, it's so emergent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: so dynamic and complex.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think I find it very hard to believe

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: we'll ever get to something as elegant

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: as Newton's laws of motions to describe a cell.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's just too complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think AI is the right tool for this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You have to start at the basic building blocks

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and use AI to run the simulation

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: for all those building blocks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So have a very strong way to do prediction

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of what given these building blocks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: what kind of biology, how the function

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and the evolution of that biological system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's almost like a cellular automata.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You have to run it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You have to take the basic ingredients,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: figure out the rules and let it run.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But in this case, the rules are very difficult

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to figure out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So the biology is too complicated to figure out the rules.
