body.input: I think the advent of intelligence and conscious intelligence and in order to us to be able

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to do science and things like that is huge as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I mean, this only evolved once as far as in earth history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So that would be a later candidate, but there's certainly for the early candidates, I think

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: multicellular life forms is huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: By the way, it's interesting to ask you if you can hypothesize about what is the origin

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is it that we started cooking meat over fire?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is it that we somehow figured out that we could be very powerful when we started collaborating?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So cooperation between our ancestors so that we can overthrow the alpha male?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What is it, Richard?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I talked to Richard Randham who thinks we're all just beta males who figured out how to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: collaborate to defeat the dictator, the authoritarian alpha male that controlled the tribe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is there other explanation?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Was there a 2001 Space Odyssey type of monolith that came down to earth?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Well, I think all of those things you suggested are good candidates, fire and cooking, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So that's clearly important for energy efficiency, cooking our meat and then being able to be

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: more efficient about eating it and consuming the energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think that's huge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And then utilizing fire and tools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think you're right about the tribal cooperation aspects and probably language is part of that

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: because probably that's what allowed us to outcompete Neanderthals and perhaps less cooperative

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: species.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So that may be the case, toolmaking, spears, axes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think it's pretty clear now that humans were responsible for a lot of the extinctions

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of megafauna, especially in the Americas when humans arrived.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you can imagine once you discover tool usage, how powerful that would have been and

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: how scary for animals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think all of those could have been explanations for it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: The interesting thing is that it's a bit like general intelligence too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's very costly to begin with to have a brain and especially a general purpose brain rather

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: than a special purpose one because the amount of energy our brains use, I think it's like

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: 20% of the body's energy and it's massive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And when you're thinking chess, one of the funny things that we used to say is it's as

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: much as a racing driver uses for a whole Formula One race.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Just playing a game of serious high level chess, which you wouldn't think just sitting

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: there because the brain's using so much energy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So in order for an animal or an organism to justify that, there has to be a huge payoff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And the problem with half a brain or half intelligence, say an IQs of like a monkey

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: brain, it's not clear you can justify that evolutionary until you get to the human level

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: brain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But how do you do that, John?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's very difficult, which is why I think it's only been done once from the specialized

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: brains that you see in animals to this sort of general purpose, truing powerful brains

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that humans have, which allows us to invent the modern world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It takes a lot to cross that barrier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think we've seen the same with AI systems, which is that maybe until very recently, it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: always been easier to craft a specific solution to a problem like chess than it has been to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: build a general learning system that could potentially do many things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Because initially, that system will be way worse than less efficient than the specialized

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So one of the interesting quirks of the human mind of this evolved system is that it appears

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to be conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This thing that we don't quite understand, but it seems very special, its ability to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: have a subjective experience that it feels like something to eat a cookie, the deliciousness

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of it or see a color and that kind of stuff.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Do you think in order to solve intelligence, we also need to solve consciousness along

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the way?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Do you think AGI systems need to have consciousness in order to be truly intelligent?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, we thought about this a lot actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think that my guess is that consciousness and intelligence are double dissociable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you can have one without the other both ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think you can see that with consciousness in that I think some animals, pets, if you

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: have a pet dog or something like that, you can see some of the higher animals and dolphins,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: things like that, have self-awareness and are very sociable, seem to dream.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: A lot of the traits one would regard as being conscious and self-aware.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But yet they're not that smart.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So they're not that intelligent by say IQ standards or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's also possible that our understanding of intelligence is flawed, like putting an IQ to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Maybe the thing that a dog can do is actually going very far along the path of intelligence

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and we humans are just able to play chess and maybe write poems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But if we go back to the idea of AGI and general intelligence, dogs are very specialized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Most animals are pretty specialized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: They can be amazing at what they do, but they're like elite sports people or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So they do one thing extremely well because their entire brain is optimized.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: They have somehow convinced the entirety of the human population to feed them and service

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So in some way they're controlling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yes, exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Well, we've co-evolved to some crazy degree, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Including the way the dogs even wag their tails and twitch their noses.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We find inexorably cute.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think you can also see intelligence on the other side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So systems like artificial systems that are amazingly smart at certain things, like maybe

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: playing Go and chess and other things, but they don't feel at all in any shape or form

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: conscious in the way that you do to me or I do to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think actually building AI, these intelligent constructs, is one of the best ways to explore

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the mystery of consciousness, to break it down.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Because we're going to have devices that are pretty smart at certain things or capable

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: at certain things, but potentially won't have any semblance of self-awareness or other things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And in fact, I would advocate if there's a choice, building systems in the first place,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: AI systems that are not conscious to begin with are just tools until we understand them

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: better and the capabilities better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So on that topic, just not as the CEO of DeepMind, just as a human being, let me ask you about

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: this one particular anecdotal evidence of the Google engineer who made a comment or

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: believed that there's some aspect of a language model, the Lambda language model that exhibited

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: sentience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you said you believe there might be a responsibility to build systems that are not sentient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And this experience of a particular engineer, I think, I'd love to get your general opinion

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: on this kind of thing, but I think it will happen more and more and more, which not when

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: engineers but when people out there that don't have an engineer background start interacting

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with increasingly intelligent systems, we anthropomorphize them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: They start to have deep impactful interactions with us in a way that we miss them when they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: gone and we sure as heck feel like they're living entities, self-aware entities, and

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: maybe even we project sentience onto them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So what's your thought about this particular system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Have you ever met a language model that's sentient?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What do you make of the case of when you kind of feel that there's some elements of sentience

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to this system?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, so this is an interesting question and obviously a very fundamental one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So first thing to say is I think that none of the systems we have today, I would say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: even have one iota of semblance of consciousness or sentience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That's my personal feeling interacting with them every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think this way premature to be discussing what that engineer talked about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think at the moment, it's more of projection of the way our own minds work, which is to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: see a sort of purpose and direction in almost anything that we...

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Our brains are trained to interpret agency basically in things, even inanimate things

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: sometimes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And of course with a language system, because language is so fundamental to intelligence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: it's going to be easy for us to anthropomorphize that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Back in the day, even the first, the dumbest sort of template chatbots ever, Eliza and

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the ilk of the original chatbots back in the 60s fooled some people under certain circumstances.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It pretended to be a psychologist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So just basically wrap it back to you, the same question you asked it back to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And some people believe that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I don't think we can...

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This is why I think the Turing test is a little bit flawed as a formal test because it depends

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: on the sophistication of the judge, whether or not they are qualified to make that distinction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think we should talk to the top philosophers about this, people like Daniel Dennett and

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: David Chalmers and others who've obviously thought deeply about consciousness.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Of course, consciousness itself hasn't been well...

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: There's no agreed definition.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If I was to speculate about that, the working definition I like is it's the way information

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: feels when it gets processed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think maybe Max Tegmark came up with that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I like that idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I don't know if it helps us get towards any more operational thing, but I think it's a

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: nice way of viewing it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think we can obviously see from neuroscience certain prerequisites that are required, like

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: self-awareness I think is necessary but not sufficient component.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This idea of a self and other and set of coherent preferences that are coherent over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: These things are maybe memory.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: These things are probably needed for a sentient or conscious being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: The difficult thing I think for us when we get, and I think this is a really interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: philosophical debate, is when we get closer to AGI and much more powerful systems than

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: we have today, how are we going to make this judgment?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: One way, which is the Turing test, is a behavioral judgment.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is the system exhibiting all the behaviors that a human sentient or a sentient being

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: would exhibit?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is it answering the right questions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is it saying the right things?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is it indistinguishable from a human and so on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think there's a second thing that makes us as humans regard each other as sentient.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Why do we think this?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I debated this with Daniel Dennett.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think there's a second reason that's often overlooked, which is that we're running on

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the same substrate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If we're exhibiting the same behavior, more or less, as humans, and we're running on the

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: same carbon-based biological substrate, the squishy few pounds of flesh in our skulls,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: then the most parsimonious, I think, explanation is that you're feeling the same thing as I'm

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: feeling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We will never have that second part, the substrate equivalence, with a machine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We will have to only judge based on the behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think the substrate equivalence is a critical part of why we make assumptions that we're

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: conscious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: In fact, even with high-level animals, why we think they might be, because they're exhibiting

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: some of the behaviors we would expect from a sentient animal, and we know they're made

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of the same things, biological neurons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We're going to have to come up with explanations or models of the gap between substrate differences

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: between machines and humans to get anywhere beyond the behavioral.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: To me, the practical question is very interesting and very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: When you have millions, perhaps billions of people believing that you have a sentient

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: AI, believing what that Google engineer believed, which I just see as an obvious, very near-term

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: future thing, certainly on the path to AGI, how does that change the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What's the responsibility of the AI system to help those millions of people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And also, what's the ethical thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Because you can make a lot of people happy by creating a meaningful, deep experience

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with a system that's faking it before it makes it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And are we the right...

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Who is to say what's the right thing to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Should AI always be tools?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Why are we constraining AI to always be tools as opposed to friends?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think, well, I mean, these are fantastic questions and also critical ones.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We've been thinking about this since the start of DeepMind and before that because we planned

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: for success and how a remote that looked like back in 2010.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We've always had these ethical considerations as fundamental at DeepMind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: My current thinking on the language models and large models is they're not ready.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We don't understand them well enough yet in terms of analysis tools and guardrails, what

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: they can and can't do and so on to deploy them at scale because I think there are big

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: still ethical questions like should an AI system always announce that it is an AI system

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to begin with?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Probably yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What do you do about answering those philosophical questions about the feelings people may have

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: about AI systems perhaps incorrectly attributed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think there's a whole bunch of research that needs to be done first to responsibly

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: before you can responsibly deploy these systems at scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That will be at least be my current position.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Over time, I'm very confident we'll have those tools like interpretability questions and

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: analysis questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Then with the ethical quandary, I think there it's important to look beyond just science.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That's why I think philosophy, social sciences, even theology, other things like that come

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: into it where arts and humanities, what does it mean to be human and the spirit of being

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: human and to enhance that and the human condition and allow us to experience things we could

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: never experience before and improve the overall human condition and humanity overall, get

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: radical abundance, solve many scientific problems, solve disease.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So this is the era I think we're heading into if we do it right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But we've got to be careful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We've already seen with things like social media how dual use technologies can be misused

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: by firstly, by bad actors or naive actors or crazy actors.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So that's that set of just the common or garden misuse of existing dual use technology.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And then of course, there's an additional thing that has to be overcome with AI that

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: eventually it may have its own agency.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So it could be good or bad in and of itself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think these questions have to be approached very carefully using the scientific method,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I would say, in terms of hypothesis generation, careful control testing, not live A-B testing

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: out in the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Because with powerful dual technologies like AI, if something goes wrong, it may cause

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: a lot of harm before you can fix it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's not like an imaging app or game app where if something goes wrong, it's relatively easy

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to fix and the harm is relatively small.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I think it comes with the usual cliche of like with a lot of power comes a lot of

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: responsibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think that's the case here with things like AI given the enormous opportunity in

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: front of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think we need a lot of voices and as many inputs into things like the design of

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the systems and the values they should have and what goals should they be put to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think as wide a group of voices as possible beyond just the technologists is needed to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: input into that and to have a say in that, especially when it comes to deployment of

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: these systems, which is when the rubber really hits the road, it really affects the general

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: person in the street rather than fundamental research.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And that's why I say, I think as a first step, it would be better if we have the choice to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: build these systems as tools to give and I'm not saying that they should never go beyond

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: tools because of course the potential is there for it to go way beyond just tools.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think that would be a good first step in order for us to allow us to carefully experiment

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: understand what these things can do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So the leap between tool, the sentient entity being is one we should take very care of.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Let me ask a dark personal question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you're one of the most brilliant people in the AI community, also one of the most

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: kind and if I may say sort of loved people in the community.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That said, creation of a super intelligent AI system would be one of the most powerful

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: things in the world, tools or otherwise.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And again, as the old saying goes, power corrupts and absolute power corrupts.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Absolutely.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You are likely to be one of the people, I would say probably the most likely person

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to be in the control of such a system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Do you think about the corrupting nature of power when you talk about these kinds of systems

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that, as all dictators and people have caused atrocities in the past, always think they're

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: doing good, but they don't do good because the power has polluted their mind about what

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is good and what is evil.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Do you think about this stuff or are we just focused on language model?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: No, I think about them all the time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think what are the defenses against that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think one thing is to remain very grounded and sort of humble no matter what you do or

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: achieve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I try to do that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: My best friends are still my set of friends from my undergraduate Cambridge days, my family's

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and friends are very important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think trying to be a multidisciplinary person, it helps to keep you humble because no matter

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: how good you are at one topic, someone will be better than you at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And always relearning a new topic again from scratch or new field is very humbling.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So for me, that's been biology over the last five years.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Huge area topic and I just love doing that, but it helps to keep you grounded and keeps

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: you open-minded.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And then the other important thing is to have a really good amazing set of people around

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: you at your company or your organization who are also very ethical and grounded themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and help to keep you that way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And then ultimately, just to answer your question, I hope we're going to be a big part of birthing

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: AI and that being the greatest benefit to humanity of any tool or technology ever and

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: getting us into a world of radical abundance and curing diseases and solving many of the

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: big challenges we have in front of us and then ultimately help the ultimate flourishing

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: of humanity to travel the stars and find those aliens if they are there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And if they're not there, find out why they're not there, what is going on here in the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This is all to come and that's what I've always dreamed about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think AI is too big an idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's not going to be...

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: There'll be a certain set of pioneers who get there first.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I hope we're in the vanguard so we can influence how that goes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think it matters who builds, which cultures they come from and what values they have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: the builders of AI systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Because I think even though the AI system is going to learn for itself most of its knowledge,

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: there'll be a residue in the system of the culture and the values of the creators of

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And there's interesting questions to discuss about that geopolitically, different cultures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: We're in a more fragmented world than ever, unfortunately.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think in terms of global cooperation, we see that in things like climate where we can't

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: seem to get our act together globally to cooperate on these pressing matters.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I hope that will change over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Perhaps if we get to an era of radical abundance, we don't have to be so competitive anymore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Maybe we can be more cooperative if resources aren't so scarce.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's true that in terms of power corrupting and leading to destructive things, it seems

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: that some of the atrocities of the past happen when there's a significant constraint on resources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think that's the first thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I don't think that's enough.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think scarcity is one thing that's led to competition, sort of zero sum game thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I would like us to all be in a positive sum world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think for that, you have to remove scarcity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I don't think that's enough, unfortunately, to get world peace because there's also other

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: corrupting things like wanting power over people and this kind of stuff, which is not

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: necessarily satisfied by just abundance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think it will help.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I think ultimately, AI is not going to be run by any one person or one organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think it should belong to the world, belong to humanity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think there'll be many ways this will happen.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And ultimately, everybody should have a say in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Do you have advice for young people in high school and college, maybe if they're interested

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: in AI or interested in having a big impact on the world, what they should do to have

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: a career they can be proud of or to have a life they can be proud of?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I love giving talks to the next generation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What I say to them is actually two things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think the most important things to learn about and to find out about when you're young

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: is what are your true passions?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: First of all, there's two things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: One is find your true passions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think you can do that by the way to do that is to explore as many things as possible

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: when you're young and you have the time and you can take those risks.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I would also encourage people to look at finding the connections between things in a unique

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think that's a really great way to find a passion.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Second thing I would say, advice is know yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So spend a lot of time understanding how you work best.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What are the optimal times to work?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What are the optimal ways that you study?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: How do you deal with pressure?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Test yourself in various scenarios and try and improve your weaknesses, but also find

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: out what your unique skills and strengths are and then hone those.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So then that's what will be your super value in the world later on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If you can then combine those two things and find passions that you're genuinely excited

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: about that intersect with what your unique strong skills are, then you're onto something

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: incredible and I think you can make a huge difference in the world.

body.input: So let me ask about know yourself.
