metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But I enjoy it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I've always been a sort of generalist in a way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And that's actually what happened in my games career after chess.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: One of the reasons I stopped playing chess was because I got into computers, but also

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I started realizing there were many other great games out there to play too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So I've always been that way inclined, multidisciplinary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And there's too many interesting things in the world to spend all your time just on one

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So you mentioned Spinoza, got asked the big, ridiculously big question about life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What do you think is the meaning of this whole thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Why are we humans here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: You've already mentioned that perhaps the universe created us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Is that why you think we're here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: To understand how the universe works?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, I think my answer to that would be, and at least the life I'm living, is to gain

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and understand knowledge, to gain knowledge and understand the universe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: That's what I think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I can't see any higher purpose than that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If you think back to the classical Greeks, the virtue of gaining knowledge, I think it's

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: one of the few true virtues is to understand the world around us and the context and humanity

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And I think if you do that, you become more compassionate and more understanding yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: and more tolerant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think all these other things may flow from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And to me, understanding the nature of reality, that is the biggest question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What is going on here is sometimes the colloquial way I say.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What is really going on here?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's so mysterious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I feel like we're in some huge puzzle.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But the world also seems to be, the universe seems to be structured in a way, why is it

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: structured in a way that science is even possible, that the scientific method works, things are

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: repeatable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It feels like it's almost structured in a way to be conducive to gaining knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Why should computers be even possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Isn't that amazing that computational or electronic devices can be possible?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And they're made of sand, our most common element that we have, silicon on the earth's

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: crust.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: They could be made of diamond or something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Then we would have only had one computer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So a lot of things are slightly suspicious to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: This puzzle sure as heck sounds like something we talked about earlier, what it takes to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: design a game that's really fun to play for prolonged periods of time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And it does seem like this puzzle, like you mentioned, the more you learn about it, the

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: more you realize how little you know.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So it humbles you but excites you by the possibility of learning more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: One heck of a puzzle we got going on here.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So like I mentioned, of all the people in the world, you're very likely to be the one

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: who creates the AGI system that achieves human level intelligence and goes beyond it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: So if you got a chance, and very well you could be the person that goes into the room

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: with the system and have a conversation, maybe you only get to ask one question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: If you do, what question would you ask her?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I would probably ask, what is the true nature of reality?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think that's the question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I don't know if I'd understand the answer because maybe it would be 42 or something

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: But that's the question I would ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And then there'll be a deep sigh from the systems like, all right, how do I explain

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to this human?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: All right, let me, I don't have time to explain.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Maybe I'll draw you a picture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It is, I mean, how do you even begin to answer that question?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Well I think it would-

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: What would you think the answer could possibly look like?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: I think it could start looking like more fundamental explanations of physics would be the beginning.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: More careful specification of that, taking you, walking us through by the hand as to

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: what one would do to maybe prove those things out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Maybe giving you glimpses of what things you totally missed in the physics of today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Here's glimpses of, no, there's a much more elaborate world or a much simpler world or

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: something.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: A much deeper, maybe simpler explanation of things, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Than the standard model of physics, which we know doesn't work, but we still keep adding

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And that's how I think the beginning of an explanation would look.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And it would start encompassing many of the mysteries that we have wondered about for

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: thousands of years, like consciousness, dreaming, life and gravity, all of these things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah, giving us glimpses of explanations for those things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Well, Damis, you're one of the special human beings in this giant puzzle of ours.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And it's a huge honor that you would take a pause from the bigger puzzle to solve this

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: small puzzle of a conversation with me today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: It's truly an honor and a pleasure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Thank you so much.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Glad to have you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Thanks for listening to this conversation with Damis Eshabas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: To support this podcast, please check out our sponsors in the description.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: And now let me leave you with some words from Edsker Dijkstra.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Computer science is no more about computers than astronomy is about telescopes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Demis Hassabis: DeepMind - AI, Superintelligence & the Future of Humanity | Lex Fridman Podcast #299

body.input: Thank you for listening and hope to see you next time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: As a side note, let me say that in these conversations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for better or worse, I seek understanding, not activism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm not left nor right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I love ideas, not labels.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And most fascinating ideas are full of uncertainty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: tension, and trade-offs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Labels destroy that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I try ideas out, let them breathe for a time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: try to challenge, explore, and analyze.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But mostly, I trust the intelligence of you, the listener,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to think and to make up your own mind, together with me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I will try to have economists and philosophers on

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from all points on the multi-dimensional political spectrum,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: including the extremes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I will try to both have an open mind

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and to ask difficult questions when needed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'll make mistakes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Don't shoot this robot at the first sign of failure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm still under development, pre-release version 0.1.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is the Lex Friedman Podcast,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and here is my conversation with Jeremy Suri.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You've studied many American presidents throughout history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So who do you think was the greatest president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in American history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The greatest American president was Abraham Lincoln.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And Tolstoy reflected on this himself, actually,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: saying that when he was in the caucuses,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he asked these peasants in the caucuses

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who was the greatest man in the world that they had heard of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and they said Abraham Lincoln.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And why?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, because he gave voice to people who had no voice before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He turned politics into an art.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is what Tolstoy recounted,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the peasants in the caucuses telling him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Lincoln made politics more than about power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He made it an art.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He made it a source of liberation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And those living even far from the United States

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: could see that model, that inspiration from Lincoln.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He was a man who had two years of education,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: yet he mastered the English language,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and he used the language to help people imagine

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a different kind of world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You see, leaders and presidents are at their best

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: when they're doing more than just manipulating institutions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and power, when they're helping the people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: imagine a better world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he did that as no other president has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you say he gave voice to those who are voiceless.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Who are you talking to about in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is this about African-Americans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or is this about just the populace in general?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Certainly part of it is about slaves, African-Americans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and many immigrants, immigrants from all parts of Europe

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and other areas that have come to the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But part of it was just for ordinary American citizens.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The Republican Party, for which Lincoln

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was the first president, was a party created

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to give voice to poor white men, as well as slaves and others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And Lincoln was a poor white man himself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Grew up without slaves and without land,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which meant you had almost nothing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What do you think about the trajectory of that man

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with only two years of education?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there something to be said about

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: how does one come from nothing and nurture the ideals

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that kind of make this country great into something

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where you can actually be a leader of this nation

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to espouse those ideas, to give voice to the voiceless?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes, I think you actually hit the nail on the head.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think what he represented was the opportunity,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and that was the word that mattered for him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: opportunity that came from the ability to raise yourself up,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to work hard, and to be compensated for your hard work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And this is at the core of the Republican Party

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of the 19th century, which is the core of capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's not about getting rich.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's about getting compensated for your work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's about being incentivized to do better work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And Lincoln was constantly striving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One of his closest associates, Herndon, said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he was the little engine of ambition that couldn't stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He just kept going, taught himself to read,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: taught himself to be a lawyer.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He went through many failed businesses

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: before he even reached that point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Many failed love affairs, but he kept trying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He kept working, and what American society offered him

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and what he wanted American society to offer everyone else

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was the opportunity to keep trying to fail

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and then get up and try again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What do you think was the nature of that ambition?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Was there a hunger for power?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think Lincoln had a hunger for success.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think he had a hunger to get out of the poor station

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he was in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He had a hunger to be someone who had control

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: over his life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Freedom for him did not mean the right

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to do anything you want to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but it meant the right to be secure

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from being dependent upon someone else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So independence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He writes in his letters when he's very young

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that he hated being dependent on his father.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He grew up without a mother.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: His father was a struggling farmer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and he would write in his letters

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that his father treated him like a slave on the farm.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Some think his hatred of slavery came from that experience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He didn't ever want to have to work for someone again.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He wanted to be free and independent,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and he wanted again, every American,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: this is the kind of Jeffersonian dream,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to be the owner of themselves

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and the owner of their future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You know, that's a really nice definition of freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We often think kind of this very abstract notion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of being able to do anything you want,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but really it's ultimately breaking yourself free

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from the constraints, like the very tight dependence

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on whether it's the institutions or on your family

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or the expectations or the community or whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: being able to be, to realize yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: within the constraints of your own abilities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's still not true freedom.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This true freedom is probably sort of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: almost like designing a video game character,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I agree, I think that's exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think freedom is not that I can have any outcome I want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I can't control outcomes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The most powerful, freest person in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: cannot control outcomes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but it means that at least I get to make choices.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Someone else doesn't make those choices for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there something to be said about Lincoln

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and on the political game front of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is he's accomplished some of them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I don't know, but it seems like

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: there were some tricky politics going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We tend to not think of it in those terms

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because of the dark aspects of slavery.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We tend to think about it in sort of ethical and human terms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but in their time, it was probably as much a game of politics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: not just these broad questions of human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It was a game.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So is there something to be said about being a skillful

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: player in the game of politics that you take from Lincoln?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Absolutely, and Lincoln never read Karl von Clausewitz,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the great 19th century German thinker on strategy and politics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but he embodied the same wisdom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is that everything is politics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If you want to get anything done,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and this includes even relationships,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: there's a politics to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What does that mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It means that you have to persuade, coerce,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: encourage people to do things they wouldn't otherwise do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And Lincoln was a master at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He was a master at that for two reasons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He had learned through his hard life to read people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to anticipate them, to spend a lot of time listening.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One thing I often tell people is the best leaders

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are the listeners, not the talkers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And then second, Lincoln was very thoughtful

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and planned every move out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He was thinking three or four moves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: maybe five moves down the chessboard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: while others were move number one or two.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's fascinating to think about him just listening,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: just studying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's, they look at great fighters in this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Like the first few rounds of boxing and mixed martial arts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you're studying the movement of your opponent

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in order to sort of define the holes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's really interesting for him to think about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there, in terms of relationships,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where do you think as president or as a politician

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is the most impact to be had?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I've been reading a lot about Hitler recently,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and one of the things that I'm more and more

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: starting to wonder, what the hell did he do alone

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in a room, one-on-one with people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Because it seems like that's where he was

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: exceptionally effective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: When I think about certain leaders,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm not sure Stalin was this way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I apologize, been very obsessed with this period

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of human history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It just seems like certain leaders

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are extremely effective one-on-one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: A lot of people think of Hitler in Lincoln

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as a speech maker, as a great charismatic speech maker.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But it seems like to me that some of these guys

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: were really effective inside a room.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What do you think?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What's more important, your effectiveness

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to make a hell of a good speech,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: sort of being in a room with many people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or is it all boiled down to one-on-one?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, I think in a sense it's both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One needs to do both, and most politicians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: most leaders are better at one or the other.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's the rare leader who can do both.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I will say that if you are going to be a figure

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who's a president or the leader of a complex organization,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: not a startup, but a complex organization

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where you have many different constituencies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and many different interests,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you have to do the one-on-one really well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Because a lot of what's going to happen

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is you're going to be meeting with people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who represent different groups, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The leader of the labor unions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the leader of your investing board, et cetera,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you have to be able to persuade them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And it's the intangibles that often matter most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Lincoln's skill, and it's the same that FDR had,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is the ability to tell a story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think Hitler was a little different,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but what I've read of Stalin is he was a storyteller too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One-on-one storyteller?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, that's my understanding is that he,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and what Lincoln did, I don't want to compare Lincoln

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to Stalin, but Lincoln did,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is he was not confrontational.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He was happy to have an argument

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if an argument were to be had,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but actually what he would try to do is move you

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: through telling a story that got you to think

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about your position in a different way,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to basically disarm you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And Franklin Roosevelt did the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Ronald Reagan did the same thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Storytelling is a very important skill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's almost heartbreaking that we don't get to have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or maybe you can correct me

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if I'm wrong on this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but it feels like we don't have a lot of information

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: how all of these folks were in private,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: one-on-one conversations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Even if we get stories about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's like, again, sorry to bring up Hitler,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but people have talked about his Pearson gaze

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: when they're one-on-one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There's a feeling like he's just looking through you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wonder, it makes me wonder,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it was Lincoln, somebody who was a little bit more passive,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: like who's more, the ego doesn't shine.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's not like an overwhelming thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Or is it more like, again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: don't wanna bring up controversial figures,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but Donald Trump, where it's more menacing, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There's a more physically menacing thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where it's almost like a bullying kind of dynamic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I wonder, I wish we knew.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wish, because from a psychological perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wonder if there's a thread

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that connects most great leaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Great question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I think the best writer on this is Max Weber, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he talks about the power of charisma,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that the term charisma comes from Weber, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And Weber's use of it actually to talk about profits.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think he has a point, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Leaders who are effective in the way you describe

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are leaders who feel prophetic,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or Weber says they have a kind of magic about them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think that can come from different sources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think that can come from the way

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: someone carries themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It can come from the way they use words.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So maybe there are different kinds of magic

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that someone develops.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But I think there are two things

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that seem to be absolutely necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: First is you have to be someone who sizes up the person

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on the other side of the table.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You cannot be the person who just comes in

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and reads your brief.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And then second, I think it's interactive.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And there is a quickness of thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So you brought up Donald Trump.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I don't think Donald Trump is a deep thinker at all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but he's quick.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think that quickness is part of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's different from delivering a lecture

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where it's the depth of your thought.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Can you for 45 minutes analyze something?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Many people can't do that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but they still might be very effective

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if they're able to quickly react,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: size up the person on the other side of the table,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and react in a way that moves that person

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the way they wanna move them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, and there's also just a couple to the quickness

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as a kind of instinct about human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Sort of asking the question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what does this person worry about?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What are the biggest problems?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Somebody, what is this, Stephen Schwartzman, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: said to me, this businessman,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think he said, what I've always tried to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is try to figure out, ask enough questions to figure out

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what is the biggest problem in this person's life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Try to get a sense of what is the biggest problem

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in their life, because that's actually

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what they care about most.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And most people don't care enough to find out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so he kind of wants to sneak up on that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and find that and then use that to then build closeness

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in order to then, probably he doesn't put in those words,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but to manipulate the person into whatever,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to do whatever the heck they want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think part of it is that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and part of the effect that Donald Trump has

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is how quick he's able to figure that out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You've written a book about how the role

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and power of the presidency has changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So how has it changed since Lincoln's time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the evolution of the presidency as a concept,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which seems like a fascinating lens

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: through which to look at American history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: As a president, we seem to only be talking

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about the presidents, maybe a general here and there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but it's mostly the story of America is often told

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: through presidents.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's right, that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And one of the points I've tried to make

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in my writing about this and various other activities

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is we use this word president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as if it's something timeless,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the office has changed incredibly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It just, from Lincoln's time to the present,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is 150 years, he wouldn't recognize the office today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And George Washington would not have recognized it

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in Lincoln, just as I think a CEO today

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: would be unrecognizable to a Rockefeller

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or a Carnegie of 150 years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So what are some of the ways in which the office has changed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'll just point to three, there are a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One, presidents now can communicate with the public directly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, we've reached the point now

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where a president can have direct,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: almost one-on-one communication.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: President can use Twitter if he so chooses

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to circumvent all media.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That was unthinkable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Lincoln, in order to get his message across,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: often wrote letters to newspapers

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and waited for the newspaper for Horace Greeley

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the New York Tribune to publish his letter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's how he communicated with the public.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There weren't even many speaking opportunities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So that's a big change, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We feel the president in our life much more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's why we talk about him much more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That also creates more of a burden.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is the second point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Presidents are under a microscope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Presidents are under a microscope.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You have to be very careful what you do and what you say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you're judged by a lot of the elements of your behavior

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that are not policy relevant.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In fact, the things we judge most

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and make most of our decisions on about individuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are often that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And then third, the power the president has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's inhuman, actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And this is one of my critiques of how the office has changed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This one person has power on a scale that's, I think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: dangerous in a democracy and certainly something

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the founders 220 years ago would have had trouble conceiving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Presidents now have the ability to deliver force

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: across the world to literally assassinate people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with a remarkable accuracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And that's an enormous power that presidents have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: To your sense, this is not to get conspiratorial,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but do you think a president currently has the power

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to initiate the assassination of somebody,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of a political enemy or a terrorist leader

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or that kind of thing, to frame that person in a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where assassination is something that he alone

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or she alone could decide to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think it happens all the time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and it's not to be conspiratorial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is how we've fought terrorism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: by targeting individuals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now you might say these were not elected leaders of state,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but these were individuals with a large following.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, the killing of Osama bin Laden

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was an assassination operation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And we've taken out very successfully

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: many leaders of terrorist organizations,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and we do it every day.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You're saying that back in Lincoln's time

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or George Washington's time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: there was more of a balance of power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: like a president could not initiate

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: this kind of assassination?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Correct, I think presidents did not have

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the same kind of military or economic power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We could talk about how a president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: can influence a market by saying something

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about where money is gonna go or singling out a company

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or critiquing a company in one way or another.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They didn't have that kind of power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now, much of the power that a Lincoln or a Washington had

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was the power to mobilize people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to then make their own decisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: At the start of the Civil War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Lincoln doesn't even have the power

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to bring people into the army.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He has to go to the governors

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and ask the governors to provide soldiers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So the governor of Wisconsin,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the governor of Massachusetts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: could you imagine that today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, so they use speeches and words

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to mobilize versus direct action in closed door environments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: initiating wars, for example.
