metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's difficult to think about,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if we look at Barack Obama, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if you're listening to this

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you're on the left or the right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: please do not make this political.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In fact, if you're a political person

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you're getting angry at the mention

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of the word Obama or Donald Trump,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: please turn off this podcast and unsubscribe.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We're not gonna get very far.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I hope we maintain a political discussion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about even the modern presidents

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that view through the lens of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think there's a lot to be learned

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about the office and about human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Some people criticize Barack Obama

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for sort of expanding the military industrial complex,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: engaging in more and more wars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as opposed to sort of the initial rhetoric

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was such that we would pull back

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from sort of be more skeptical

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in our decisions to wage wars.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So from the lens of the power of the presidency,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as the modern presidency,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the fact that we continued the war in Afghanistan

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: at different engagements in military conflicts,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: do you think Barack Obama could have stopped that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Do you put the responsibility on that expansion on him

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because of the implied power that the presidency has?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Or is this power just sits there

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and if the president chooses to take it, they do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and if they don't, they don't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Almost like you don't want to take on the responsibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because of the burden of that responsibility.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So a lot of my research is about this exact question,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: not just with Obama.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And my conclusion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and I think the research is pretty clear on this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is that structure has a lot more effect on us

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: than we like to admit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is to say that the circumstances,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the institutions around us drive our behavior

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: more than we like to think.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So Barack Obama, I'm quite certain,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: came into the office of the presidency committed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to actually reducing the use of military force overseas

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and reducing presidential war-making power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: As a trained lawyer, he had a moral position on this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: actually, and he tried,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and he did withdraw American forces from Iraq

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and was of course criticized by many people for doing that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But at the same time,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he had some real problems in the world to deal with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: terrorism being one of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And the tools he has are very much biased

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: towards the use of military force.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's much harder as president to go and get Vladimir Putin

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and Xi Jinping to agree with you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's much easier to send these wonderful toys we have

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and these incredible soldiers we have over there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And when you have Congress, which is always against you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's also easier to use the military

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because you send them there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And even if members of Congress from your own party

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or the other are angry at you,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: they'll still fund the soldiers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: No member of Congress wants to vote

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to starve our soldiers overseas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So they'll stop your budget.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They'll even threaten not to pay the debt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but they'll still fund your soldiers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so you are pushed by the circumstances you're in

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to do this and it's very hard to resist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So that's, I think the criticism of Obama,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the fair one would be that he didn't resist the pressures

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that were there, but he did not make those pressures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So is there something about putting the responsibility

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on the president to form the structure around him locally

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: such that he can make the policy that matches the rhetoric?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So what I'm talking to is hiring.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So basically just everybody you work with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you have power as a president to fire and hire

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or to basically schedule meetings in such a way

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that can control your decision-making.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I imagine it's very difficult to get out of Afghanistan

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or Iraq when most of your scheduled meetings

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are with generals or something like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But if you reorganize the schedule

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you reorganize who you have late night talks with,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you potentially have a huge ripple effect on the policy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think who has access to the president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is absolutely crucial.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And presidents have to be more strategic about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They tend to be reacting to crises

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because every day has a crisis.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And if you're reacting to a crisis,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you're not controlling access

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because the crisis is driving you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So that's one element of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But I also think,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and this is the moment we're in right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: presidents have to invest in reforming the system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the system of decision-making.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Should we have a national security council

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that looks the way it does?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Should our military be structured the way it is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The founding fathers wanted a military that was divided.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They did not want a unified department of defense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That was only created after World War II.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Should we have as large a military as we have?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Should we be in as many places?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There are some fundamental structural reforms

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we have to undertake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And part of that is who you appoint,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but part of that is also how you change the institutions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The genius of the American system

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is that it's a dynamic system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It can be adjusted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It has been adjusted over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's the heroic story.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The frustrating story is it often takes us a long time

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to make those adjustments

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: until we go into such bad circumstances

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that we have no choice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So in the battle of power of the office of the president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: versus the United States military,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the department of defense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: do you have a sense that the president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: has more power ultimately?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So to decrease the size of the department of defense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to withdraw from any wars or increase the amount of wars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is the president, you're kind of implying the president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: has a lot of power here in this scale.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes, the president has a lot of power and we are fortunate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And it was just proven in the last few years

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that our military uniquely among many countries

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with large militaries is very deferential to the president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and very restricted in its ability

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to challenge the president.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So that's a strength of our system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But the way you reform the military

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is not with individual decisions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's by having a strategic plan

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that re-examines what role it plays.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So it's not just about whether we're in Afghanistan or not.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The question we have to ask is when we look at our toolbox

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of what we can do in our foreign policy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are there other tools we should build up

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and therefore some tools in the military we should reduce?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's the broader strategic question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Let me ask you the most absurd question of all

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you did not sign up for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but it's especially, I've been hanging out

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with a guy named Joe Rogan recently.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So it's very important for me and him to figure this out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If a president, because you said,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you implied the president is very powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If a president shows up and the US government is in fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in possession of aliens, alien spacecraft,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: do you think the president will be told?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: A more responsible adult historian question version of that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is there some things that the machine of government

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: keeps secret from the president?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Or is the president ultimately at the very center?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So if you like map out the set of information and power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you have like CIA, you have all these organizations

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that like that do the machinery of government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: not just like the passing of bills,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but like gaining information, homeland security,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: actually like engaging in wars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you know, all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How central is the president?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Would the president know some of the shady things

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that are going on?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Aliens or some kind of cybersecurity stuff

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: against Russia and China, all those kinds of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is the president really made aware?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And if so, how nervous does that make you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So presidents like leaders of any complex organizations

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: don't know everything that goes on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They have to ask the right questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is Machiavelli.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Most important thing a leader has to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is ask the right questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You don't have to know the answers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's why you hire smart people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but you have to ask the right questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So if the president asks the US government,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: those who are responsible for the aliens

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or responsible for the cyber warfare against Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: they will answer honestly, they will have to,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but they will not volunteer that information in all cases.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So the best way a president can operate

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is to have people around him or her

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who are not the traditional policy makers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is where I think academic experts are important,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: suggesting questions to ask

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to therefore try to get the information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Makes me nervous because I think human nature is such that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the academics, the experts, everybody

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is almost afraid to ask the questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for which the answers might be burdensome.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes, that's right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you can get into a lot of trouble not asking,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's the old elephant in the room.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Correct, correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is exactly right and too often mediocre leaders

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and those who try to protect them try to shield themselves.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They don't want to know certain things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So this is part of what happened with the use of torture

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: by the United States, which is a war crime

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: during the war on terror.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: President Bush at times intentionally did not ask

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and people around him prevented him from asking

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or discouraged him from asking questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he should have asked to know about what was going on.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And that's how we ended up where we did.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You could say the same thing about Reagan and Iran-Contra.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wonder what it takes to be the kind of leader

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that steps in and asks some difficult questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So aliens is one, UFO spacecraft, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Another one, yeah, torture is another one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The CIA, how much information is being collected

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about Americans?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I can see as a president being very uncomfortable

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: asking that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Because if the answer is a lot of information

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is being collected by Americans,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: then you have to be the guy who lives with that information.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: For the rest of your life, you have to walk around.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You're probably not going to reform that system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's very difficult.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You probably have to be very picky

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about which things you reform.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You don't have much time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It takes a lot of sort of effort to restructure things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But you nevertheless would have to be basically lying

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to yourself, to others around you

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about the unethical things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Depends of course what the ethical system is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wonder what it takes to ask those hard questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wonder if how few of us can be great leaders like that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I wonder if our political system,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the electoral system, such that makes it likely

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that such leaders will come to power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's hard and you can't ask all the right questions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and there is a legal hazard

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if you know things at certain times.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But I think you can, back to your point on hiring,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you can hire people who will do that in their domains.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And then you have to trust that when they think

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's something that's a question you need to ask,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: they'll pass that on to you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is why it's not a good idea to have loyalists,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because loyalists will shield you from things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's a good idea to have people of integrity

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who you can rely on and who you think

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: will ask those right questions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And then pass that down through their organization.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What's inspiring to you?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What's insightful to you about several of the presidencies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: throughout the recent decades?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there somebody that stands out to you that's interesting

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and sort of in your study of how the office has changed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, Bill Clinton is one of the most fascinating figures.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Why can't I apologize?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Bill Clinton just puts a smile on my face

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: every time somebody mentions him at this point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I don't know why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's charisma, I suppose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, and he's a unique individual,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but he fascinates me because he's a figure

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of such enormous talent and enormous appetite

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and such little self-control and such extremes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think it's not just that he tells us something

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about the presidency, he tells us something

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about our society, American society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is not new to our time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's filled with enormous reservoirs of talent

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and creativity, and those have a bright and a dark side.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you see both with Bill Clinton.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In some ways, he's the mirror of the best

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and worst of our society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And maybe that's really what presidents are in the end.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They're mirrors of our world

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that we get the government we deserve,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we get the leaders we deserve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wish we embraced that a little bit more.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: A lot of people criticize Donald Trump

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for certain human qualities that he has.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: A lot of people criticize Bill Clinton

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for certain human qualities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I wish we kind of embraced the chaos of that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You know, because he does, you're right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in some sense represent, I mean,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he doesn't represent the greatest ideal of America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the flawed aspect of human nature is what he represents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and that's the beautiful thing about America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the diversity of this land with the mix of it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the corruption within capitalism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the beauty of capitalism, the innovation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: all those kinds of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the people that start from nothing and create everything

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the Elon Musk's of the world and the Bill Gates and so on,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but also the people, Bernie Madoffs,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and all as the Me Too movement has showed,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the multitude of creeps that apparently permeate

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the entirety of our system.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I don't know, there is something,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: there is some sense in which we put our president

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on a pedestal, which actually creates a fake human being.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The standard we hold them to is forcing the fake politicians

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to come to power versus the authentic one,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is in some sense the promise of Donald Trump

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is like, it's a definitive statement of authenticity.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's like, this the opposite of the fake politician,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's whatever else you wanna say about him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is there's the chaos that's unlike anything else

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that came before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One thing, and this is a particular maybe preference

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and quirk of mine, but I really admire,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: maybe I'm romanticizing the past again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I romanticize the presidents

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that were students of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They were almost like king philosophers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: great, that made speeches that reverberated

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: through decades after.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We kind of, using the words of those presidents,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: whether written by them or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we tell the story of America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I don't know, even Obama has been an exceptionally good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as far as I know, I apologize if I'm incorrect on this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but from everything I've seen,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he was a very deep scholar of history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I really admire that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is that through the history of the office of the president,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: through the history of the office of the presidency,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is that just your own preference

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or is that supposed to come with a job?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Are you supposed to be a student of history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think, I mean, I'm obviously biased as a historian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I do think it comes with a job.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Every president I've studied

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: had a serious interest in history.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now, how they pursued that interest would vary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Obama was more bookish, more academic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So was George W. Bush in strange ways.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: George H.W. Bush was less so, but George H.W. Bush

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: loved to talk to people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So he would talk to historians, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Ronald Reagan loved movies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and movies were an insight into history for him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He likes to watch movies about another time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It wasn't always the best of history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but he was interested in what is

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a fundamental historical question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How has our society developed?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How has it grown and changed over time?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And how has that change affected who we are today?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's the historical question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's really interesting to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I do a lot of work with business leaders and others too.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You reach a certain point in any career

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you become a historian

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because you realize that the formulas

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and the technical knowledge that you've gained

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: got you to where you are.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But now your decisions are about human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Your decisions are about social change

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and they can't be answered technically.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They can only be answered by studying human beings.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And what is history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's studying the laboratory of human behavior.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: To sort of play devil's advocate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I kind of, especially in the engineering scientific domains,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I often see history holding us back.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Sort of the way things were done in the past

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are not necessarily going to hold the key

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to what will progress us into the future.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Of course, with history in studying human nature,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it does seem like humans are just the same.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's just like the same problems over and over.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So in that sense, it feels like history has all the lessons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: whether we're talking about wars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: whether we're talking about corruption,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: whether we're talking about economics.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think there's a difference between

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: history and antiquarianism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So antiquarianism, which some people call history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is the desire to go back to the past

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or stay stuck in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Or antiquarianism is the desire to have the desk

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that Abraham Lincoln sat at.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Wouldn't it be cool to sit at his desk?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'd love to have that desk.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If I had a few extra million dollars,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'd acquire it, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So in a way, that's antiquarianism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's trying to capture and hold on, hold on to the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The past is a talisman for antiquarians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What history is, is the study of change over time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's the real definition of historical study

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and historical thinking.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so what we're studying is change.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so a historian should never say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we have to do things the way we've done them in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The historian should say,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we can't do them the way we did them in the past.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We can't step in the same river twice.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Every podcast of yours is different from the last one.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You plan it out and then it goes in its own direction.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And what are we studying then in history?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We're studying the patterns of change

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and we're recognizing we're part of a pattern.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So what I would say to the historian

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who's trying to hold the engineer back,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'd say, no, don't tell that engineer not to do this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: As a small aside,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I constantly tried to think,

body.input: in the Soviet Union?

body.input: So the thing that people don't often talk about

body.input: It feels like,

body.input: here's this great leader, FDR,

body.input: that he already probably had a great positive impact,

body.input: but had a chance to stop maybe World War II

body.input: or stop some of the evils.

body.input: When you look at how weak Hitler was from much of the 30s

body.input: relative to militarily, relative to everything else,

body.input: how many people could have done a lot to stop him?

body.input: And FDR in particular didn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He tried to play, not pacify,

body.input: but basically do diplomacy and let Germany do Germany,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and he basically said to FDR,

body.input: First, he had an American public

body.input: The opposite of the problem in a sense

body.input: that we were talking about before.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If we're an over-militarized society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He had to be conscious of that.

body.input: He had to know his audience.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And second, there were no allies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: willing to invest in this either.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And there are a number of historians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and it's an endless debate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so, you know, even there race comes in

body.input: I suspect that they're not telling me the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If it's traumatic, it's hard to talk about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, sometimes I wonder how much for my own life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: everything that I've ever done is just the result

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of the complicated relationship with my father.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I tend to, I had a really difficult time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I did a podcast conversation with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I saw it actually.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, it's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's great.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I regret everything.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I could never do that with my father.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But I remember as I was doing it

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and for months after I regretted doing it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I just kept regretting it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And the fact that I was regretting it spoke to the fact

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that I'm running away from some truths

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that are back there somewhere.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And that's perhaps what Kissinger is as well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But is there, I mean, he's been a part

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of so many interesting moments of American history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of world history, from the Cold War, Vietnam War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: until today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What stands out to you as a particularly important moment

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in his career that made who he is?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, I think what made his career in many ways

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was his experience in the 1950s, building a network,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a network of people across the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who were rising leaders from unique positions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He ran what he called the International Seminar at Harvard,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which was actually a summer school class

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that no one at Harvard cared about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But he invited all of these rising intellectuals

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and thinkers from around the world.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he built a network there that he used forevermore.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So that's what really, I think, boosts him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The most important moments in terms of making

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: his reputation, making his career,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are two sets of activities.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One is the opening to China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And his ability to, first of all, take control

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of US policy without the authority to do that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and direct US policy, and then build a relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with Mao Zedong and Zhou Enlai that was unthinkable

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: just four or five years earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Of course, President Nixon is a big part of that as well,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but Kissinger is the mover and shaker on that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And it's a lot of manipulation, but it's also a vision.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now this is in the moment of American history

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where there's a very powerful anti-communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So communism is seen as much more even

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: than today as the enemy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And China in particular, they were one of our key enemies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in Vietnam.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And in Korea, American forces were fighting

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Chinese forces directly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Chinese forces come over the border,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: thousands of Americans die at the hand of Chinese forces.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So for the long time, the United States had no relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with communist China.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He opens that relationship.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And at the same time, he also creates a whole new dynamic

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the Middle East.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: After the 1973 war, the so-called Yom Kippur War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he steps in and becomes the leading negotiator

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: between the Israelis, the Egyptians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and other major actors in the region.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And it makes the United States the most powerful actor

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the Middle East, the Soviet Union far less powerful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is great for the United States in the 70s and 80s.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It gets us though into the problems we of course

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: have thereafter.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So that speaks to the very pragmatic approach

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that he's taken, the realistic approach

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: versus the idealistic approach,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: termed realpolitik.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What is this thing?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What is this approach to world politics?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So realpolitik for Kissinger is really focusing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on the power centers in the world

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and trying as best you can to manipulate those power centers

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to serve the interests of your own country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so that's why he's a multilateralist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He's not a unilateralist.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He believes the United States should put itself

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: at the center of negotiations

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: between other powerful countries.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But that's also why he pays very little attention

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to countries that are less powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And this is why he's often criticized

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: by human rights activists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: For him, parts of Africa and Latin America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which you and I would consider important places

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are unimportant because they don't have power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They can't project their power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They don't produce a lot of economic wealth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so they matter less.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Realpolitik views the world in a hierarchy of power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How does realpolitik realize itself in the world?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What does that really mean?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Like how do you push forward the interests

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of your own country?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You said there's power centers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but it is a big bold move to negotiate,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to work with a communist nation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with your enemies that are powerful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What is the sort of, if you can further elaborate

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the philosophy behind it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Sure, so there are two key elements

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180
