body.input: that then end up producing all kinds of tactics,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the two strategic elements of Kissinger's way

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of thinking about realpolitik,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which are classical ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: going back to Thucydides and the Greeks,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are to say, first of all,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you figure out who your allies are

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you build webs of connection

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: so that your allies help you to acquire

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what you want to acquire.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is why, according to Herodotus,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the Greeks beat the Persians.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The Persians are bigger,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the Greeks, the Spartans, the Athenians,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: all those are able to work together

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and leverage their resources.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So it's about leveraging your resources for Kissinger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This makes Western Europe crucially important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It makes Japan crucially important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It makes Israel and Egypt crucially important, right,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in building these webs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You build your surrogates,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you build your brother states.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In other parts of the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you build tight connections

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you work together to control

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the resources that you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The second element of the strategy

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is not to go to war with your adversary,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but to do all you can to limit the power of your adversary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Some of that is containment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: preventing the Soviet Union from expanding.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That was the key element of American Cold War policy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But sometimes it's actually negotiation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's what Détente was about for Kissinger.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He spends a lot of time, more time

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: than any other American foreign policymaker,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: negotiating with Soviet leaders,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as well as Chinese leaders.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What does he want to do?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He wants to limit the nuclear arms race.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The United States is ahead.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We don't want the Soviet Union to get ahead of us.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We negotiate to limit their abilities, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We play to our strengths.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So it's a combination of keeping your adversary down

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and building tight webs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Within that context, military force is used,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but you're not using war for the sake of war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You're using warfare to further your access

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to the resources, economic, political,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: geographic that you want.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: To build relationships, and then the second thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to limit the powers of those you're against.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Exactly.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So is there any sort of insights

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: into how he preferred to build relationships?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Are we talking about, again, it's the one-on-one?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is it through policy or is it through phone conversations?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there any cool insights that you could speak to?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, Kissinger is the ultimate kiss-up.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He is, some used to make fun of him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In fact, even the filmmaker from Dr. Strangelove,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: whose name I'm forgetting, Stanley Kubrick,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: called him kiss-up at that time, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He had a wonderful way of figuring out

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what it is you wanted, back to that discussion we had before,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and trying to show how he could give you more

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of what you wanted as a leader.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It was very personalistic, very personalistic.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he spends a lot of time, for example,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: kissing up to Leonid Brezhnev, kissing up to Mao.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He tells Mao, you're the greatest leader

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the history of the 20th century.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: People will look back on you as the great leader.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Some of this sounds like BS, but it's serious, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He's feeding the egos of those around him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Second, he is willing to get things done for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He's effective.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You want him around you because of his efficacy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So Richard Nixon is always suspicious

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that Henry Kissinger's getting more of the limelight.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He hates that Kissinger gets the Nobel Peace Prize

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and he doesn't, but he needs him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Because Kissinger's the guy who gets things done.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So he performs, he builds a relationship,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in almost, I say this in the book,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in almost a gangster way he didn't like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that he criticized that part of the book.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But again, I still think the evidence is there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You need something to be done, boss, I'll do it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And don't forget that I'm doing this for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you get mutual dependency in a Hegelian way, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so he builds this personal dependency

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: through ego and through performance.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And then he's so skillful at making decisions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for people who are more powerful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because he's never elected to office.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He always needs powerful people to let him do things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But he convinces you it's your decision when it's really his.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: To read his memos are beautiful.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He's actually very skilled at writing things

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in a way that looks like he's giving you options

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as president, but in fact, there's only one option there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is he, speaking to the gangster, to the loyalty,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is he ever, like the sense I got from Nixon

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is he would, Nixon would backstab you if he needed to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: One of the things that I admire about gangsters

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is they don't backstab those in the inner circle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: like loyalty above all else.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, at least that's the sense I've gotten

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from the stories of the past, at least.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is, where would you put Kissinger on that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is he loyalty above all else?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Or is it, are human, it's like the Steve Jobs thing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is like, as long as you're useful, you're useful,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but then once, long use, the moment you're no longer useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is when you're knocked off the chessboard.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's the latter with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He's backstabbing quite a lot.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he's self-serving.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But he also makes himself so useful

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that even though Nixon knows he's doing that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Nixon still needs him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: By the way, on that point, so having spoken with Kissinger,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what's your relationship like with him as somebody

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who is in an objective way writing his story?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It was very difficult because he's very good

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: at manipulating people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And we had about 12 or 13 interviews,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: usually informal over lunch.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And this was many years ago,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: this is probably now more than 10 years ago.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Did you find yourself being sweet-talked,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to where you go back home later and look in the mirror

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and it's like, wait, what just happened?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He can be enormously charming

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and enormously obnoxious at the same time.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I would have these very mixed emotions

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because he gives no ground.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He is unwilling to, and I think this is a weakness,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he's unwilling to admit mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Others make mistakes, but he doesn't.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he certainly won't take on any of the big criticisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that are pushed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I understand why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, when you've worked as hard for what he has

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as he has, you're defensive about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But he is very defensive and he's very fragile about it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He does not like criticisms at all.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He used to, he hasn't done this in a while,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but he used to call me up and yell at me on the phone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: quite literally, when I would be quoted

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the New York Times or somewhere saying something

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that sounded critical of him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So for instance, there was one instance

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a number of years ago where a reporter came

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: across some documents where Kissinger said negative things

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about Jews in Russia, typical things

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that a German Jew would say about East European Jews.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And the New York Times asked me, is this accurate?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I said, yeah, the documents are accurate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I've seen them, they're accurate.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He was so angry about that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So there's the fragility, but there's also

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the enormous charm and the enormous intelligence.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The real challenge with him though is he's very good

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: at making his case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He'll convince you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And as a scholar, as an observer,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you don't wanna hear a lawyer's case.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You wanna actually interrogate the evidence

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and get to the truth.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so that was a real challenge with him.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So speaking of his approach of Realpolitik,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if we just zoom out and look at a human history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: human civilization, what do you think works best

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the way we progress forward?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: A realistic approach, do whatever it takes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: control the centers of power, to play a game

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for the greater interests of the good guys, quote unquote,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or lead by sort of idealism, which is like truly act

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the best version of the ideas you represent

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as opposed to kind of present one view

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and then do whatever it takes behind the scenes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Obviously you need some of both,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I lean more to the idealistic side

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and more so actually believe it or not,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as I get into my forties, as I do more historical work.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Why do I say that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Because I think, and this is one of my criticisms

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of Kissinger, who I also have a lot of respect for,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the Realpolitik becomes self-defeating

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because you're constantly running to keep power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but you forget why.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you often then use power,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and I think Kissinger falls into this

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in some of his worst moments, not all of his moments,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where the power is actually being used

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to undermine the things you care about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's sort of the example of being a parent

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you're doing all these things to take your kid

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to violin, basketball, all these things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you realize you're actually killing your kid

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and making your kid very unhappy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And the whole reason you were doing it

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was to improve the person's life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so you have to remember why it is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what Hans Morgenthau calls this is your purpose.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Your purpose has to drive you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now your purpose doesn't have to be airy-fairy idealism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I believe deeply in democracy as an ideal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I don't think it's gonna ever look like Athenian democracy,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but that should drive our policy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But we still have to be realistic

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and recognize we're not gonna build that democracy

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in Afghanistan tomorrow.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, does it ultimately just boil down again

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to the corrupting nature of power

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that nobody can hold power for very long

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: before you start acting in the interest of power

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as opposed to in the interest of your ideals?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's impossible to be somebody like Kissinger

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who is essentially in power for many, many decades

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and still remember what are the initial ideals

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you strove to achieve.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes, I think that's exactly right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There's a moment in the book I quote about him

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: comes from one of our interviews.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I asked him,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what were the guiding ideals for your policies?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And he said, I'm not prepared to share that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I don't think it's because he doesn't know

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what he thinks he was trying to do.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: He realizes his use of power departed quite a lot from.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So it would sound, if he made them explicit,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it would sound hypocritical.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Correct.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, on that, let me ask about war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: America often presents itself to its own people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but just the leaders, when they look in the mirror,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I get a sense that we think of ourselves as the good guys.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Especially this begins sometimes to look hypocritical

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: when you're waging war.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there a good way to know when you've lost all sense

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of what it is to be good?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Another way to ask that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is there in military policy, in conducting war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is there a good way to know what is a just war

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and what is a war crime?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, in some circles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Kissinger is accused of contributing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: being a war criminal.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes, and I argue in the book he's not a war criminal,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but that doesn't mean that he didn't misuse military power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think a just war,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a just war as Michael Walzer and others write about it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a just war is a war where both the purpose is just

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you are using the means to get to that purpose

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that kill as few people as necessary.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That doesn't mean they won't be killing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but as few as necessary, proportionality, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Your means should be proportional to your ends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And that's often lost sight of,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because the drive to get to the end often self-justifies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: means that go well beyond that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And so that's how we get into torture in the war on terror.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Is there some kind of lesson for the future?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You can take away from that?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yes, I think the first set of lessons

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that I've shared as a historian

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with military decision makers is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: first of all, always remember why you're there,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what your purpose is, and always ask yourself

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if the means you're using,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if the means you're using are actually proportional.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Ask that question.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Just because you have these means that you can use,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: just because you have these tools,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: doesn't mean they're the right tools to use.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And here's the question that follows from that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And it's a hard question to ask,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because the answer is one we often don't like to hear.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Are the things I'm doing in war actually doing more harm

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or more good to the reason I went into war?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We came to a point in the war on terror

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: where what we were doing was actually creating more terrorists.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And that's when you have to stop.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, some of that is in the data,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but some of it, there's a leap of faith.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So from a parenting perspective,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: let me speak as a person with no kids and a single guy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Let me be the expert in the room on parenting.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: No, it does seem that it's a very difficult thing to do

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to even though you know that your kid was making a mistake,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to let them make a mistake,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to give them the freedom to make the mistake.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Sure.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I don't know what to do,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I mean, that's a very kind of lighthearted way

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of phrasing the following,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is when you look at some of the places in the world,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: like Afghanistan, which is not doing well.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Right.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: To move out knowing that there's going to be a lot

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of suffering, economic suffering, injustices,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: terrorist organizations growing,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that committing crimes on its own people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and potentially committing crimes against allies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: violence against allies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: violence against the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How do you know what to do in that case?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, again, it's an art, not a science,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is what makes it hard for an engineer to think about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is what makes it endlessly fascinating for me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think the real intellectual work

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is at the level of the art, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think probably engineering at its highest level

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: becomes an art as well, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So policymaking, you never know, but I will say this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'll say you have to ask yourself and look in the mirror

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and say, is all the effort I'm putting in

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: actually making this better?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And in Afghanistan, you look at the 20 years

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and two plus trillion dollars that the US has put in.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And the fact that, as you said correctly,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's not doing well right now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: after 20 years of that investment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I might like a company that I invest in,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but after 20 years of my throwing money in that company,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it's time to get out.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Well, in some sense, getting out now is,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that's kind of obvious.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm more interested in how we figure out in the future

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: how to get out earlier.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, at this point, we stayed too long and it's obvious,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the data, the investment, nothing is working.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The very little data points to us staying there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm more interested in being in a relationship,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: let me take it back to a safer place again,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: being in a relationship and getting out of that relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: while things are still good,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but you have a sense that it's not going to end up

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in a good place.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's the difficult thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You have to ask yourself whether it's a relationship

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or you're talking about policymaking

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in a place like Afghanistan,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are the things I'm doing showing me evidence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: real evidence that they're making things better

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or making things worse?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's a hard question to ask.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Be honest with yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You have to be very honest and in a policymaking context,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we have to actually do the same thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we do in a relationship context.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What do we do in a relationship context?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We ask other friends who are observing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We ask for other observers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: This is actually just a scientific method element,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: actually, that we can't, the Heisenberg principle,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I can't see it because I'm too close to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm changing it by my looking at it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I need others to tell me in a policymaking context,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: this is why you need to hear from other people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: not just the generals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because here's the thing about the generals.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They generally are patriotic, hardworking people,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but they're too close.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They're not lying.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They're too close.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They always think they can do better.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How do you think about the Cold War now

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from the beginning to end?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And maybe also with an eye towards

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the current potential cyber conflict,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: cyber war with China and with Russia,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if we look sort of other kind of Cold Wars

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: potentially emerging in the 21st century,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: when you look back at the Cold War of the 20th century,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: how do you see it and what lessons do we draw from it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's a wonderful question

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because I teach this to undergraduates

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and it's really interesting to see how undergraduates now,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: almost all of whom were born after 9-11.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So the Cold War is ancient history to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In fact, the Cold War to them is as far removed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as the 1950s were to me.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, it's unbelievable.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's almost like World War II for my generation

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and Cold War for them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's so far removed.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The collapse of the Soviet Union

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: doesn't mean anything to them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So-

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So how do you describe the Cold War to them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: How do you describe the Soviet Union to them?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: First of all, I have to explain to them

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: why people were so fearful of communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Anti-communism is very hard for them to understand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The fact that in the 1950s, Americans believed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that communists were going to infiltrate our society

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and many other societies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and that after Fidel Castro comes to power in 1959,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that we're going to see communist regimes

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: all across Latin America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that fear of communism married to nuclear power

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and then even the fear that maybe economically

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: they would outpace us because they would create

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: this sort of army of Khrushchevian,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you know, builders of things.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you know, what does Khrushchev said, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Say we're going to catch Britain in five years

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and then the United States after that, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So to explain that sense of fear to them

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that they don't have of those others,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that's really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The Cold War was fundamentally about the United States

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: defending a capitalist world order

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: against a serious challenger from communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: An alternative way of organizing everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: private property, economic activity, enterprise, life,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: everything organized in a totally different way.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It was a struggle between two systems.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So your sense is, and sorry to interrupt,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but your sense is that the conflict of the Cold War

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: was between two ideologies and not just two big countries

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: with nuclear weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think it was about two different ways of life

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or two different promoted ways of life.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The Soviet Union never actually lived communism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I think my reading of Stalin is

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: he really tried to go there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Khrushchev really believed Gorbachev thought he was going

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to reform the Soviet Union so you would go back

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to a kind of Buhar and Lenin communism, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I do think that mattered.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I do think that mattered enormously.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And for the United States point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the view was that communism and fascism

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: were these totalitarian threats to liberal democracy

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and capitalism, which went hand in hand.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So I do think that's what the struggle was about.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And in a certain way, liberal capitalism proved

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to be the more enduring system

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and the United States played a key role in that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's the reality of the Cold War,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I think it means different things now

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to my students and others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They focus very much on the expansion of American power

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and the challenges of managing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They're looking at it from the perspective

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of not will we survive, but did we waste our resources

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on some elements of it?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It doesn't mean they were against what America did,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but there is a question of the resources that went

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: into the Cold War and the opportunity costs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And you see this when you look at the sort

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of healthcare systems that other countries build

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and you compare them to the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Race issues also.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So they look at the costs, which I think often happens

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: after a project is done, you look back at that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Second, I think they're also more inclined

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to see the world as less bipolar,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to see the role of China as more complicated.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Post-colonial or anti-colonial movements,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: independent states in Africa and Latin America,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that gets more attention.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So one of the criticisms now is because you forget

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the lessons of 20th century history

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and the atrocities committed under communism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you may be a little bit more willing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to accept some of those ideologies

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: into our United States society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That forgetting that capitalistic forces are part

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of the reason why we have what we have today.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There's a fear amongst some now that we would have,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we would allow basically communism to take hold in America.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I mean, Jordan and others speak to this kind of idea.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I tend to not be so fearful of it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think it's on the surface, it's not deep within.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I do see the world as very complicated

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as they're needing to be a role of having support

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for each other on certain political levels,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: economic levels, and then also supporting entrepreneurs.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's like that the kind of enforcing of outcomes

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that is fundamental to the communist system

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is not something we're actually close to.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And some of that is just fear mongering

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for likes on Twitter kind of thing.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: If I could come in on that, because I agree with you 100%.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I've spent a lot of time writing and looking at this

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and talking to people about this.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There's no communism in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There never has been, and there certainly isn't now.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I'll say this both from an academic point of view,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but also from just spending a lot of time observing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: young people in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Even those on the farthest left,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: take whoever you think is the farthest left.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They don't even understand what communism is.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: They're not communist in any sense.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Americans are raised in a vernacular and environment

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of private property ownership.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And as you know better than anyone,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if you believe in private property,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: you don't believe in communism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So what the sort of Bernie Sanders kind of socialist elements

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that's very different, right?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I would say some of that, not all of that,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: some of that does hearken back

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to actually what won in the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: There were many social democratic elements

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of what the United States did

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that led to our winning the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: For example, the New Deal was investing government money

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in propping up business, in propping up labor unions.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And during the Cold War, we spent more money

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: than we had ever spent in our history

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on infrastructure, on schools,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on providing social support, social security,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: our national pension system being one of them.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So you could argue actually that social democracy

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is very compatible with capitalism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think that's the debate we're having today,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: how much social democracy.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'd also say that the capitalism we've experienced,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the last 20 years is different

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from the capitalism of the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: During the Cold War, there was the presumption

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in the United States that you had to pay taxes

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to support our Cold War activities,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that it was okay to make money,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the more money you made, the more taxes you had to pay.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: We had the highest marginal tax rates

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: in our history during the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now the aversion to taxes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and of course no one ever likes paying taxes,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the notion that we can do things on deficit spending,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that's a post-Cold War phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That's not a Cold War phenomenon.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So much of the capitalism that we're talking about today

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180
