body.input: is not the capitalism of the Cold War.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And maybe, again, we can learn that

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and see how we can reform capitalism today

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and get rid of this false worry

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: about communism in the United States.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Yeah, you know what?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You make me actually realize something important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: What we have to remember is the words we use

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: on the surface about different policies,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what you think is right and wrong,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is actually different than the core thing

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that is in your blood, the core ideas that are there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I do see the United States as this,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: there's this fire that burns of individual freedoms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of property rights,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: these basic foundational ideas

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that everybody just kind of takes for granted.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think if you hold on to them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: if you're raised in them,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: talking about ideas of social security,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of universal basic income, of reallocation of resources

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is a fundamentally different kind of discussion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: than you had in the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think the value of the individual

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is so core to the American system

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you basically cannot possibly do the kind of atrocities

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you saw in the Soviet Union.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But of course, you never know,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the slippery slope has a way of changing things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but I do believe the things you're born with

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is just so core to this country.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It's part of the, I don't know what your thoughts are,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: we are in Texas.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Not necessarily, I don't necessarily wanna have

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: a gun control type of conversation,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but the reason I really like guns,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it doesn't make any sense,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but philosophically, it's such a declaration

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of individual rights that's so different

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: than the conversations I hear with my Russian family

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and my Russian friends.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That the gun, it's very possible that having guns

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is bad for society in the sense that like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: it'll lead to more violence,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but there's something about this discussion that like,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that proclaims the value of my freedom as an individual.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I'm not being eloquent in it,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but there's very few debates where whenever people are saying,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: should you have what level of gun control,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: all those kinds of things,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: what I hear is it's a fight for how much freedom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: even if it's stupid freedom, should the individual have.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think that's what's articulated quite often.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think combining your two points, which are great points,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think there is something about American individualism,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is deeply ingrained in our culture and our society.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And it means that the kinds of bad things that happen

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are different, usually not as bad,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but our individualism often covers up for vigilante activity

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and individual violence toward people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you wouldn't have in a more collective culture.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So in the Soviet Union, it was at a much worse scale

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and it was done by government organizations.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: In the United States, it's individuals,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: the history of lynching in our country, for example.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Sometimes it's individual police officers,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: sometimes it's others.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Again, the vast majority of police officers are good people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and don't do harm to people, but there are these examples

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: and they are able to fester in our society

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: because of our individualism.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Now, gun ownership is about personal freedom,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think, for a lot of people.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And there's no doubt that in our history,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: included in the Second Amendment,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which can be interpreted in different ways,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: is the presumption that people should have the right

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: to defend themselves,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which is what I think you're getting at here,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that you should not be completely dependent

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for your defense on an entity that might not be there for you.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: You should be able to defend yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And guns symbolize that.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think that's a fair point.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: But I think it's also a fair point to say

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: that as with everything,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: defining what self-defense is, is really important.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So does self-defense mean I can have a bazooka?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Does it mean I can have weapons that are designed

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for a military battlefield to mass kill people?

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That seems to me to be very different

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: from saying I should have a handgun

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: or some small arm to defend myself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: That distinction alone would make a huge difference.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: Most of the mass shootings, at least,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which are a proportion, a smaller proportion

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: of the larger gun deaths in the United States,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: which are larger than any other society,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but at least the mass shootings

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: are usually perpetrated by people

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: who have not self-defense weapons,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: but mass killing, mass killing weapons.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: And I think there's an important distinction there.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: The Constitution talks about a right to bear arms

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: for a well-regulated militia.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: When the framers talked about arms,

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: as you want to kill.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: It meant the ability to defend yourself.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: So let's have that conversation.

metadata.title: Podcast: Jeremi Suri: History of American Power | Lex Fridman Podcast #180

body.input: I think it would be useful as a society.

body.input: Stop talking about guns or no guns.

body.input: What is it that we as citizens need

body.input: Yes.

body.input: The following is a conversation with Ian Hutchinson, a nuclear engineer and plasma physicist at MIT.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: He has made a number of important contributions in plasma physics, including the magnetic confinement of plasmas,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: seeking to enable fusion reactions, which happens to be the energy source of the stars, to be used for practical energy production.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: Current nuclear reactors, by the way, are based on fission, as we discuss.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: Ian has also written on the philosophy of science and the relationship between science and religion,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: arguing in particular against scientism, which is a negative description of the overreach of the scientific method to questions not amenable to it.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: On this latter topic, I recommend two of his books, his new one, Can a Scientist Believe in Miracles,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: where he answers more than 200 questions on all aspects of God and science, and his earlier book on scientism called Monopolizing Knowledge.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: As you may have seen already, I work hard on having an open mind, always questioning my assumptions,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: and in general marvel at the immense mystery of everything around us and the limitations of at least my mind.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: I'm not religious myself in that I don't go to the synagogue, a church, a mosque,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: but I see the beautiful bond in the community that religion at its best can create.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: I also see, both in scientists and religious leaders, signs of arrogance, hypocrisy, greed, and a will to power.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: We're human.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: Whether Buddhist, Christian, Hindu, Jewish, Muslim, agnostic, or atheist,

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: this podcast is my humble attempt to explore a complicated human nature.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: What Stanislav Lem in his book Solaris called our own labyrinth of dark passages and secret chambers.

metadata.title: Podcast: Ian Hutchinson: Nuclear Fusion, Plasma Physics, and Religion | Lex Fridman Podcast #112

body.input: I ask that you try to keep an open mind as well and be patient with the limitations of mind.
